body.zh: 在欧盟提议让加拿大成为其第一个准成员后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁要对欧盟征收“严厉关税”并削减贸易，称这个想法“可笑”。 美国总统暗示此举是“敌对行为”，他告诉记者，他可以征收“非常严厉的关税或停止与欧洲的贸易”。他补充道：“如果是善意，那很好。如果是恶意，我们将对欧洲征收非常高的关税。” 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩昨天坚称，“这不是针对其他任何人的伙伴关系，而是为了我们共同的力量”，副首席发言人奥洛夫·吉尔今天早上重申了这一立场，以回应特朗普隔夜的威胁。 刚刚观看完埃弗顿在利物浦战胜狼队的联赛杯比赛的加拿大总理马克·卡尼将于上午晚些时候在欧洲议会发表讲话。让我们看看他对此有什么要说的。 另外，我们的注意力越来越多地转向德国，四面楚歌的德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨将于今天在柏林参加竞选活动，本周末将举行两场州选举，这可能决定他的政治未来。 由于猜测他的任期可能屈指可数，来自该党的强大德国国家领导人纷纷团结起来支持总理，他取消了下周出席联合国大会的行程。 我们的柏林记者黛博拉·科尔 (Deborah Cole) 将于上午 11 点过后加入我们，回答您有关梅尔茨的未来、两次州选举以及德国下一步的问题。您可以从上午 9 点开始将您的问题在下面留言给她。 今天是 2026 年 9 月 17 日，星期四，我是 Jakub Krupa，这里是 Europe Live。

reflection.en: In response to the EU's proposal for a partnership with Canada, President Trump has threatened "serious tariffs" and trade cuts, framing the move as a "hostile act." The European Commission president, however, insists the partnership is for "common strength." This exchange highlights the delicate balance in international relations, where actions can be...
reflection.zh: 针对欧盟提出的与加拿大的伙伴关系提议，特朗普总统威胁要实施“严重关税”和贸易削减，并将此举定性为“敌对行为”。然而，欧盟委员会主席坚持认为该伙伴关系是为了“共同力量”。这种交流凸显了国际关系中微妙的平衡，行动可能被不同地解读，从而导致潜在的冲突而非互利。‘与众人和睦’的呼吁在这样的外交紧张局势中是一个持续的挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that "where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety." This principle applies not only to voters discerning candidates but also to the candidates themselves, who must...
reflection.zh: 在政治这个充满变数的领域，微弱的优势可能决定选举结果，因此寻求明智的建议至关重要。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们：“没有指导，人民就败落；谋士众多，就能得胜。”这一原则不仅适用于选民在辨别候选人时，也适用于候选人本身，他们必须通过深思熟虑和多元化的视角来应对移民等棘手的政策决策。

title.en: All smiles in Strasbourg but uncertainty clouds Canada’s EU membership plan
title.zh: 斯特拉斯堡皆大欢喜，但加拿大欧盟成员国计划蒙上不确定性阴影

body.en: Although Mark Carney welcomed offer to become bloc’s first associate member, no one seems to know what that means Europe live – latest updates Mark Carney received a rapturous reception in the European parliament when he gave his speech on Thursday welcoming a proposal for Canada to become the EU’s first-ever associate member. Politicians queued to shake his hand and take selfies. One MEP leader described the speech as a historic moment. “Europe has extended a hand, and Canada has taken it,” said the German Green MEP Terry Reintke, who borrowed a Canadian ice hockey shirt for the occasion. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The prospect of Canada becoming the EU's first associate member is met with enthusiasm, as seen in the warm reception for Mark Carney. Yet, the path forward is clouded by uncertainty about what this new relationship truly entails. This situation calls for leaders to govern with integrity and wisdom, ensuring that such political developments are rooted in...
reflection.zh: 加拿大可能成为欧盟首个准成员国的提议受到了热烈欢迎，正如马克·卡尼所受到的接待一样。然而，前方的道路却笼罩着对这种新关系真正含义的不确定性。这种情况呼唤领导者以正直和智慧来治理，确保这些政治发展植根于公义，并服务于共同利益。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
title.zh: 南非警方调查一系列女性死亡事件，已发现第九具女性尸体

summary.en: South African police are investigating a series of unexplained deaths of women, with the ninth body discovered recently. While police caution against assuming a link, the incidents have caused widespread fear among women in the region.
summary.zh: 南非警方正在调查一系列不明原因的女性死亡事件，最近已发现第九具尸体。尽管警方警告不要假设所有死亡都有关联，但这些事件已在当地女性中引起广泛恐惧。

body.en:
Police in South Africa have confirmed the discovery of a ninth woman's body in just two months, amid growing concern over a string of unexplained deaths east of Johannesburg.

The latest victim was found half-naked and wrapped in a sheet on the side of a road in Dawn Park on Thursday morning, police said. Her identity has not yet been released.

The discovery follows the deaths of eight other women whose bodies have been found since July across Ekurhuleni, a major urban area of Johannesburg.

Several of the women were found partially clothed and with injuries, but police have stressed that they have not established whether all the deaths are connected or whether a serial killer is responsible.

The latest body is of a woman believed to be in her 30s and appeared to have bruises and stab wounds, local media reported.

The discovery has sparked fear in the area, particularly among women who say they no longer feel safe.

"We are scared to come out of our houses. We are scared to go to the shops. We are no longer free in a country where we are supposed to be safe as women," local resident Bongeka Sebela told the BBC.

President Cyril Ramaphosa has vowed that "no stone will be left unturned" in finding those behind the killings , which he said were "causing fear and uncertainty in our communities".

Among the victims was 38-year-old Elizabeth "Tsontso" Moselakgomo, who disappeared last week after leaving her home for an afternoon run. Her body was found three days later behind a hotel in Kempton Park.

Two other victims have since been identified as Itumeleng Kekana, who had been missing since July, and 38-year-old Dineo Evelyn Motapane, whose body was discovered by the roadside in KwaThema on Tuesday.

The first of the nine bodies was discovered in Kempton Park on 15 July. A suspect was arrested two days later in connection with that case and remains in custody, but police have not linked that suspect to the other deaths.

Further bodies were discovered in August and September, including in Kempton Park, Olifantsfontein, Clayville and KwaThema.

Police have assembled a multidisciplinary team of detectives, intelligence officers, forensic experts and other specialists to investigate the deaths and establish whether there are links between the cases.

They are also pursuing a person of interest, although they have not disclosed which case or cases that person may be connected to.

"Let's not get emotional, the gloves are off," said Gauteng Premier Panyaza Lesufi on Thursday, adding that the authorities had the capacity to deal with the killings.

In a statement on Thursday, South African police said the recent rise in serious and violent crimes against women remained a "matter of grave concern", urging women in the country to remain vigilant about their...
body.zh: 南非警方证实，在短短两个月内发现了第九具女性尸体，人们对约翰内斯堡东部一系列不明原因死亡事件的担忧日益加剧。 警方称，周四早上，最新的受害者被发现半裸，裹着床单在黎明公园的路边。她的身份尚未公布。 此前，自七月以来，在约翰内斯堡主要城区埃库胡莱尼 (Ekurhuleni) 地区又发现了另外八名妇女的尸体。 几名妇女被发现时衣不蔽体，身上有伤，但警方强调，他们尚未确定所有死亡事件是否有关联，也不确定是否是连环杀手所为。 据当地媒体报道，最新的尸体是一名 30 多岁的女性，身上似乎有瘀伤和刀伤。 这一发现引发了该地区的恐惧，尤其是那些表示自己不再感到安全的女性。 当地居民邦格卡·塞贝拉 (Bongeka Sebela) 告诉 BBC：“我们不敢走出家门，不敢去商店。在一个女性应该安全的国家，我们不再自由。” 总统西里尔·拉马福萨发誓，将“不遗余力”寻找杀戮的幕后黑手，他说这些杀戮“在我们的社区造成了恐惧和不确定性”。 受害者中包括 38 岁的伊丽莎白·“松措”·莫塞拉科莫 (Elizabeth "Tsontso" Moselakgomo)，她上周离开家去下午跑步后失踪。三天后，她的尸体在肯普顿公园的一家酒店后面被发现。 另外两名受害者已被确认，分别是自 7 月以来失踪的 Itumeleng Kekana 和 38 岁的 Dineo Evelyn Motapane，后者的尸体于周二在 KwaThema 的路边被发现。 7 月 15 日，九具尸体中的第一具在肯普顿公园被发现。两天后，一名与该案有关的嫌疑人被捕，目前仍被拘留，但警方尚未将该嫌疑人与其他死亡事件联系起来。 8 月和 9 月，在肯普顿帕克、Olifantsfontein、Clayville 和 KwaThema 等地发现了更多尸体。 警方组建了一个由侦探、情报官员、法医专家和其他专家组成的多学科小组来调查死亡事件，并确定案件之间是否存在联系。 他们还在追捕一名感兴趣的人，尽管他们没有透露该人可能与哪起案件有关。 豪登省省长帕尼亚扎·勒苏菲周四表示：“我们不要情绪化，我们已经脱掉手套了。”他补充说，当局有能力处理这些杀戮事件。 南非警方在周四的一份声明中表示，最近针对妇女的严重暴力犯罪事件的增加仍然是一个“严重关切的问题”，敦促该国妇女对自己的...

reflection.en: The discovery of a ninth woman's body east of Johannesburg casts a shadow of fear over the community. In times of such vulnerability, the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, and to advocate for justice and safety, becomes urgent. May compassion move us to action for the protection of the vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 在约翰内斯堡东部发现第九具女性尸体，给社区蒙上了一层恐惧的阴影。在如此脆弱的时刻，为那些无法为自己发声的人挺身而出、倡导公正和安全的呼声变得尤为迫切。愿怜悯之心促使我们采取行动，保护弱者。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Exotic animal smuggling baffles activists in India
title.zh: 印度活动人士对异宠走私感到困惑

summary.en: Orangutans, rare reptiles, and other exotic animals are appearing in India, suggesting the country is becoming a major hub for trafficked wildlife. Five infant orangutans were recently found abandoned in a forest in India's eastern Odisha state, prompting Indonesia to request information on their origin and...
summary.zh: 红毛猩猩、稀有爬行动物和其他异国动物出现在印度，这表明该国正成为野生动物走私的主要目的地。最近，五只年幼的红毛猩猩在印度东部奥里萨邦的一片森林中被发现遗弃，促使印度尼西亚要求提供其来源信息并遣返。

body.en:
Orangutans, rare reptiles and other exotic animals are popping up in India, suggesting the country is becoming a major destination for trafficked wildlife.

Five infant orangutans, a species found only on the  Indonesian   island of Sumatra and on Borneo, were found in a forest by rangers patrolling in the Balasore district of India's eastern Odisha state last week.

Indonesia's Forestry Ministry has asked India to establish the origin of the abandoned orangutans, known for their shaggy red fur, and return them if they are found to have come from their usual habitat abroad.

The rescue of the rare apes has raised fresh questions about how exotic animals enter India and how the country is used in the illegal wildlife trade.

"The discovery on the eastern coast of India is a bit mind-boggling. It's like that time a few years ago when live kangaroos were found wandering along the highways of West Bengal," Kanitha Krishnasamy, Southeast Asia director at wildlife trade monitoring network TRAFFIC, told DW.

"What are orangutans doing in India? Were they smuggled from their native Malaysia or Indonesia or did they come from a facility?" she asked.

The Odisha government has asked the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau to investigate how the critically endangered animals reached the state. 

"These animals are not found in India and are mostly seen in the rainforests of Malaysia, Indonesia, Borneo and Sumatra in Southeast Asia," said Odisha's Forest and Environment Minister Ganesh Ram Singh Khuntia.

"We suspect that they might have been released in the Balasore district forest… by an international wildlife smuggling racket."

The orangutans are the latest in a series of exotic wildlife being seized in India.

In November 2024, authorities in the Indian city of Bengaluru seized 40 rare animals arriving from the Malaysian capital, Kuala Lumpur, including Aldabra giant tortoises, gibbons, American alligators and iguanas.

In June 2025, Mumbai Customs seized 284 exotic animals arriving in four consignments from the Thai capital, Bangkok, including snakes and tortoises.

In July 2025, customs officials in the Indian city of Pune intercepted 20 exotic animals from passengers arriving from Bangkok. They included 14 green tree pythons, four double-eyed fig parrots and two Sumatran striped rabbits. 

According to figures from TRAFFIC, 7,272 individual animals, alive and dead, were seized from passenger baggage in smuggling attempts between Thailand and India between January 2022 and May 2025, with more than 80% of interceptions taking place in India.

The animals included reptiles, birds and mammals — many apparently destined for the exotic pet trade.

"We have found hundreds of species and thousands of individuals being trafficked into India through...
body.zh: 红毛猩猩、稀有爬行动物和其他外来动物在印度不断出现，表明该国正在成为贩运野生动物的主要目的地。 上周，护林员在印度东部奥里萨邦巴拉索尔地区巡逻时，在森林中发现了五只仅在印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛和婆罗洲发现的猩猩幼崽。 印度尼西亚林业部已要求印度确定这些被遗弃的猩猩的来源，如果发现它们来自国外的惯常栖息地，则将其归还。这些猩猩以其蓬松的红色皮毛而闻名。 对稀有猿类的救援引发了新的问题：外来动物如何进入印度以及该国如何被用于非法野生动物贸易。 “印度东海岸的这一发现有点令人难以置信。就像几年前在西孟加拉邦的高速公路上发现活袋鼠一样，”野生动物贸易监测网络TRAFFIC东南亚主任Kanitha Krishnasamy告诉德国之声。 “猩猩在印度做什么？它们是从家乡马来西亚或印度尼西亚走私来的，还是来自某个设施？”她问道。 奥里萨邦政府已要求野生动物犯罪控制局调查这些极度濒危动物是如何到达该州的。 奥里萨邦森林和环境部长加内什·拉姆·辛格·昆蒂亚 (Ganesh Ram Singh Khuntia) 表示：“这些动物在印度没有发现，主要出现在马来西亚、印度尼西亚、婆罗洲和东南亚苏门答腊岛的雨林中。” “我们怀疑它们可能是被国际野生动物走私团伙释放到巴拉索尔地区森林中的。” 这些猩猩是印度查获的一系列外来野生动物中最新的一种。 2024年11月，印度班加罗尔当局查获了从马来西亚首都吉隆坡运来的40只珍稀动物，包括亚达伯拉象龟、长臂猿、美洲短吻鳄和鬣蜥。 2025 年 6 月，孟买海关查获了从泰国首都曼谷运来的四批货物中的 284 只珍奇动物，其中包括蛇和乌龟。 2025 年 7 月，印度浦那市的海关官员从曼谷抵达的旅客中截获了 20 只珍奇动物。其中包括 14 条绿树蟒、四只双眼无花果鹦鹉和两只苏门答腊条纹兔。 根据 TRAFFIC 的数据，2022 年 1 月至 2025 年 5 月期间，在泰国和印度之间的走私活动中，从乘客行李中查获了 7,272 只活的和死的动物，其中超过 80% 的拦截发生在印度。 这些动物包括爬行动物、鸟类和哺乳动物——许多显然是注定要进行外来宠物贸易的。 “我们发现数百个物种和数千个个体通过......被贩运到印度。

reflection.en: The discovery of abandoned infant orangutans in India underscores the hidden suffering of trafficked animals. These creatures, far from their natural habitat, are voiceless victims in a global trade. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, reminding us of our responsibility to advocate for the vulnerable, whether human...
reflection.zh: 在印度发现被遗弃的年幼红毛猩猩，凸显了被贩运动物隐藏的痛苦。这些生物远离它们的自然栖息地，是全球贸易中无声的受害者。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们为那些不能为自己发声的人发声，提醒我们有责任为弱势群体——无论是人类还是动物——进行倡导。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Klopp wants to 'reclaim' flag amid German elections
title.zh: 克洛普希望在德国大选背景下“收复”国旗

summary.en: New Germany coach Jurgen Klopp stated that his team can help ensure "national pride is not entrusted to the wrong people" following a recent far-right election victory. The AfD party secured a significant vote share in Saxony-Anhalt and is expected to perform well in upcoming regional elections.
summary.zh: 德国新任主教练尤尔根·克洛普表示，在近期极右翼选举获胜后，他的球队可以帮助确保“国家骄傲不落入错误的人手中”。德国选择党在萨克森-安哈尔特州获得了可观的选票份额，并有望在即将举行的地区选举中取得好成绩。

body.en:
New Germany coach Jurgen Klopp says his team can help ensure "national pride is not entrusted to the wrong people" after a recent far-right election victory.

The Alternative for Germany (AfD) party won 43.8% of the vote in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt, falling just short of securing an absolute majority in the regional parliament.

The anti-immigration party also expects strong results in elections on Sunday in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

Speaking at a news conference to announce his first squad, Klopp stressed he is not a political "expert" but added: "We had an election where some people may have thought it was OK, while others were saying, 'my God, what is happening here?'

"From my perspective as a sportsman, I can say that I would very much like to reclaim the flag for myself, for all of us.

"I want it so that when someone waves it, no one thinks: 'What is wrong with you?' Instead, I want people to understand: You are happy and realise how lucky you were to be born, grow up, or move to this wonderful country."

No far-right party has controlled a German state since World War Two, when the ruling Nazi party carried out the Holocaust.

"I do not want to entrust national pride to the wrong people," said Klopp, who prefers the term "positive patriotism" to "national pride", which he fears can be misunderstood.

The former Liverpool boss added: "I can be proud to be German while also being open-minded and diverse, and kind and friendly."

Klopp also said it was more important that the country had enough doctors and caregivers but said football can "foster a sense of community, so that people can truly feel the power of sport".

Klopp named 16 uncapped players in a 44-man squad for four upcoming Nations League matches over the space of two weeks.

A group of 24 players will be available against the Netherlands in Amsterdam on 24 September and at home to Greece in Augsburg three days later.

Most of those players will then return to their clubs while the other 20 players will join the group before Germany face Serbia in Munich on 1 October and Greece in Thessaloniki on 4 October.

The first group includes Premier League trio Kai Havertz (Arsenal), Kevin Schade (Brentford) and Anton Stach (Leeds), while Jamal Musiala is selected after twice collapsing during pre-season games for Bayern Munich.

Brentford's Vitaly Janelt has received his first call-up as part of the second group, which also includes Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) and Malick Thiaw (Newcastle).

Goalkeeper Manuel Neuer and defender Antonio Rudiger retired from international duty after Germany's second-round exit against Paraguay at this summer's World Cup.

That led to the departure of coach Julian Nagelsmann and the subsequent appointment of Klopp, who had been working...
body.zh: 德国新任主教练尤尔根·克洛普表示，在最近极右翼选举获胜后，他的团队可以帮助确保“民族自豪感不会被托付给错误的人”。 德国另类选择党 (AfD) 在东部萨克森-安哈尔特州赢得了 43.8% 的选票，距离在地区议会中获得绝对多数席位仅差一点。 反移民党还预计周日在柏林和梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚举行的选举将取得强劲结果。 在宣布他的第一支球队的新闻发布会上，克洛普强调他不是政治“专家”，但他补充道：“我们进行了一次选举，有些人可能认为这没什么问题，而另一些人则说，‘天啊，这里发生了什么事？’” “从我作为一名运动员的角度来看，我可以说我非常想为自己、为我们所有人夺回旗帜。 “我希望当有人挥舞它时，没有人会想：‘你怎么了？’相反，我希望人们理解：你很快乐，并意识到你出生、成长或移居到这个美好的国家是多么幸运。” 自第二次世界大战以来，没有极右翼政党控制过德国国家，当时执政的纳粹党实施了大屠杀。 克洛普说：“我不想把民族自豪感托付给错误的人。”他更喜欢“积极爱国主义”这个词，而不是“民族自豪感”，他担心这个词可能会被误解。 这位前利物浦主帅补充道：“我为自己是德国人而感到自豪，同时我也很开放、多元化、善良和友好。” 克洛普还表示，更重要的是这个国家有足够的医生和护理人员，但他表示足球可以“培养社区意识，让人们真正感受到体育的力量”。 克洛普提名了 44 人大名单中的 16 名未参加比赛的球员，他们将参加两周内即将举行的四场欧国联比赛。 由 24 名球员组成的小组将于 9 月 24 日在阿姆斯特丹对阵荷兰，三天后在奥格斯堡主场对阵希腊。 这些球员中的大多数将返回各自的俱乐部，而其他 20 名球员将在德国于 10 月 1 日在慕尼黑对阵塞尔维亚以及 10 月 4 日在塞萨洛尼基对阵希腊之前加入该组。 第一组包括英超三人组凯·哈弗茨（阿森纳）、凯文·沙德（布伦特福德）和安东·斯塔赫（利兹），而贾马尔·穆西亚拉在拜仁慕尼黑季前赛中两次倒地后入选。 布伦特福德队的维塔利·贾内特作为第二组的一员首次获得征召，第二组还包括弗洛里安·维尔茨（利物浦）和马利克·蒂奥（纽卡斯尔）。 德国队在今年夏天的世界杯第二轮对阵巴拉圭队后，门将曼努埃尔·诺伊尔和后卫安东尼奥·鲁迪格退出了国家队比赛。 这导致教练朱利安·内格尔斯曼的离开，以及随后一直在工作的克洛普的任命......

reflection.en: In the face of rising nationalist sentiment, Jurgen Klopp's call for his team to embody a healthier national pride is a powerful reminder. Proverbs 14:34 teaches that righteousness exalts a nation, suggesting that true national identity is built on justice and integrity, not on exclusionary ideologies.
reflection.zh: 面对日益增长的民族主义情绪，尤尔根·克洛普呼吁他的球队体现更健康的民族自豪感，这是一个有力的提醒。箴言14:34教导我们，公义使邦国高升，这表明真正的国家认同是建立在公正和正直之上的，而不是排外的意识形态。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Fact check: How disinformation fuels Houthi-Saudi conflict
title.zh: 事实核查：虚假信息如何助长胡塞武装与沙特冲突

summary.en: As fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia escalates, old and repurposed videos have flooded social media, with many presented as fresh footage from the front lines.
summary.zh: 随着胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间战事的升级，旧的及被重新利用的视频充斥社交媒体，许多被当作来自前线的最新画面。

body.en:
As fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia escalates, old and repurposed videos have flooded social media, with many presented as fresh footage from the front lines.

The conflict between Yemen's Houthi  rebels and Saudi Arabia has sharply escalated in recent days, with Houthi forces making rapid gains along the Red Sea coast and taking control of key areas around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

Saudi Arabia has responded  with airstrikes. Houthi forces have launched drones and missiles towards Saudi territory . The renewed fighting has also raised concerns about global trade  via the Red Sea .

The conflict has also spread online, where significant disinformation has circulated.

DW's fact-checking team examined what is circulating and why a conflict that is so hard to observe independently leaves so much room for this kind of disinformation.

One nine-second clip has gone viral. It shows a huge explosion between buildings, with fireballs and screaming in the background.

Claim: A user posted the video on X with the Arabic caption "Yemeni forces are carrying out the strongest strikes in various areas in Saudi Arabia, including Abha." The video has more than 340,000 views. 

It was also posted in other languages , falsely claiming that it showed real footage from the current fighting.

The video is not only old, but also artificially generated. There are several visual clues in the clip such as the pattern of the explosions and the uniform way the smoke spreads.

A large-scale explosion of this kind would also have generated a very bright flash, and nearby buildings would likely have collapsed or at least had their windows shattered. Neither appears to have happened. 

One can also see, in the final seconds of the video, how a lamppost appears out of nowhere in the middle of the frame.

The audio is mostly unintelligible, but the speaker's tone does not appear to change after the huge explosion. Such a large explosion would normally be expected to trigger some audible reaction in the speaker's voice. 

On the technical side, Hive Moderation's AI detection analysis also confirmed that the video was artificially generated.

The very same video was shared  this June , then claiming to show explosions in Iran, as we found with a reverse image search.

Hannah Porter has spent years researching fake news and disinformation in Yemen and the country's wider information environment. She says this has been happening for years.

"There is less international attention in Yemen than there might be in other conflicts around the world. And, because there is not sufficient attention paid to Yemen, I think that allows more space for disinformation to spread not only within Yemen and in...
body.zh: 随着胡塞武装和沙特阿拉伯之间的战斗升级，旧视频和重新调整用途的视频充斥着社交媒体，其中许多都是来自前线的新鲜镜头。 也门胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间的冲突近日急剧升级，胡塞武装在红海沿岸迅速取得进展，并控制了曼德海峡周边的关键地区。 沙特阿拉伯以空袭作为回应。胡塞武装向沙特境内发射了无人机和导弹。新一轮的战斗也引发了人们对红海全球贸易的担忧。 冲突还在网上蔓延，大量虚假信息在网上传播。 德国之声的事实核查团队调查了正在流传的内容，以及为何如此难以独立观察的冲突为此类虚假信息留下了如此大的空间。 一段 9 秒的视频已经疯传。它显示建筑物之间发生巨大爆炸，背景中有火球和尖叫声。 声明：一名用户在 X 上发布了该视频，并附有阿拉伯语标题“也门军队正在沙特阿拉伯多个地区进行最猛烈的打击，其中包括艾卜哈。” 该视频的观看次数已超过 340,000 次。 它还以其他语言发布，错误地声称它显示了当前战斗的真实镜头。 该视频不仅年代久远，而且还是人工生成的。剪辑中有一些视觉线索，例如爆炸的模式和烟雾扩散的均匀方式。 这种大规模爆炸也会产生非常明亮的闪光，附近的建筑物可能会倒塌或至少窗户被震碎。两者似乎都没有发生。 人们还可以看到，在视频的最后几秒钟，一根灯柱是如何突然出现在画面中间的。 音频大多难以理解，但扬声器的音调在巨大爆炸后似乎没有变化。如此大的爆炸通常会在说话者的声音中引发一些可听见的反应。 在技​​术方面，Hive Moderation的AI检测分析也证实该视频是人工生成的。 今年 6 月分享了同一个视频，然后声称显示了伊朗的爆炸，正如我们通过反向图像搜索发现的那样。 汉娜·波特花了数年时间研究也门以及该国更广泛的信息环境中的假新闻和虚假信息。她说这种情况已经发生很多年了。 “与世界各地的其他冲突相比，也门受到的国际关注较少。而且，由于对也门的关注不够，我认为这为虚假信息的传播提供了更多的空间，不仅在也门内部，而且......

reflection.en: In times of conflict, the lines between truth and falsehood can become dangerously blurred. The spread of old or manipulated videos as current events fuels the flames of war, making reconciliation even harder. We are called to speak truth, to be discerning, and to resist the temptation to amplify what we know to be untrue, especially when it inflames hatred.
reflection.zh: 在冲突时期，真相与谎言之间的界限可能变得极其模糊。将旧的或被操纵的视频当作当前事件传播，只会火上浇油，使和解更加困难。我们被呼召要讲真话，要有辨别力，并抵制那些会煽动仇恨的虚假信息的传播，尤其是在我们明知其不实的情况下。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Swedish PM Kristersson resigns after election loss
title.zh: 瑞典首相克里斯特松因选举失利而辞职

summary.en: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has resigned after his right-wing bloc narrowly lost the general election to the center-left opposition, led by Magdalena Andersson.
summary.zh: 瑞典首相乌尔夫·克里斯特松在中间偏左反对派以微弱优势赢得大选后宣布辞职，马格达莱纳·安德松将领导新政府。

body.en:
Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has resigned after his ruling right-wing bloc was narrowly defeated by the centre-left opposition in the country's general election.

He made the announcement in a post on X on Thursday afternoon, after preliminary votes from Sunday's election showed about 50,000 votes separated the two blocs in the country of about 10 million people.

Opposition parties led by Magdalena Andersson of the Social Democrats look set to win 176 seats in the 349-seat Riksdag, Sweden's parliament.

Kristersson, a conservative, had been supported in government by the anti-immigration hard-right Sweden Democrats (SD), and had promised them cabinet jobs if he won the election.

His right-wing bloc looks set to win 173 seats in the Riksdag, according to data from the Swedish Election Authority.

The results will be subject to formal certification in the coming days and are expected to finalised this weekend.

In Sweden, there are two major political blocs - with four parties on the right and four on the left, so Swedes are used to coalition and minority governments.

After a prime minister resigns, the Speaker of the Riksdag holds talks with all parties to proposes a candidate for the next leader, which is then voted on by MPs.

"Now it is the speaker who will lead the next stage of the way to a new government. I am herewith requesting that I be relieved of the office of prime minister to allow that work to start immediately," Kristersson's statement read.

In a speech posted on Instagram, Andersson said: "The Swedish people have voted for a new direction for our country".

The Social Democrats have regularly led Swedish governments since World War Two and have been the country's dominant political force for much of the last century.

Its leader, Andersson, is expected to return to power after four years in opposition, and has initiated talks with the other opposition parties - The Left Party, The Centre Party and The Green Party - about forming a government.

But discussions could drag on due to major differences between the parties on issues such as taxes.

After the 2022 election in Sweden, it took 37 days to form a government, while in 2018 it took 134 days.

In his resignation, Kristersson said the opposition faced "complicated" conditions for forming the next government, "because the parties' various statements before election day could pose obstacles".

The right-wing bloc is formed of Kristersson's Moderates, as well as the SD, the Christian Democrats and the Liberals.

The SD were founded by Nazi sympathisers in the 1980s and were shunned for decades by the mainstream.

But the party has rebranded itself since the mid-2000s, culminating in a watershed moment in 2022 when it became Sweden's second-largest party on a campaign...
body.zh: 瑞典总理乌尔夫·克里斯特松在其执政的右翼集团在该国大选中被中左翼反对派以微弱优势击败后辞职。 周四下午，他在 X 上的一篇帖子中宣布了这一消息，此前周日选举的初步投票显示，在这个拥有约 1000 万人口的国家中，两个阵营之间有约 5 万张选票相分离。 由社会民主党马格达莱娜·安德森领导的反对党有望在瑞典议会 349 个席位中赢得 176 个席位。 克里斯特森是一名保守派，在政府中得到了反移民的极右翼瑞典民主党（SD）的支持，并承诺如果他赢得选举，他们将获得内阁职位。 根据瑞典选举管理局的数据，他的右翼集团有望在议会中赢得 173 个席位。 结果将在未来几天内接受正式认证，预计将于本周末最终确定。 在瑞典，有两个主要的政治集团——四个政党在右翼，四个政党在左翼，因此瑞典人习惯于联合政府和少数派政府。 首相辞职后，议长与各党派举行会谈，提出下一任领导人的候选人，然后由国会议员投票表决。 克里斯特森在声明中写道：“现在议长将领导新政府的下一阶段工作。我特此请求解除我的总理职务，以便立即开始这项工作。” 安德森在 Instagram 上发布的演讲中表示：“瑞典人民投票支持我们国家的新方向”。 自第二次世界大战以来，社会民主党一直领导瑞典政府，并在上个世纪的大部分时间里一直是该国的主导政治力量。 其领导人安德森预计在四年的反对后重新掌权，并已开始与其他反对党——左翼党、中间党和绿党——就组建政府进行谈判。 但由于双方在税收等问题上存在重大分歧，讨论可能会拖延。 2022年瑞典大选后，组建政府用了37天，而2018年则用了134天。 克里斯特森在辞职时表示，反对派在组建下一届政府时面临着“复杂”的条件，“因为各党派在选举日之前的各种声明可能会构成障碍”。 右翼集团由克里斯特森领导的温和党、社会民主党、基督教民主党和自由党组成。 SD 由纳粹同情者于 20 世纪 80 年代创立，几十年来一直受到主流社会的回避。 但该党自 2000 年代中期以来一直在重塑自己，并在 2022 年成为瑞典第二大政党的分水岭时刻达到顶峰……

reflection.en: In the ebb and flow of political fortunes, the narrow margin of Sweden's recent election underscores the transient nature of power. Prime Minister Kristersson's resignation, following his bloc's defeat, reminds us that leadership is ultimately held in trust. As Psalm 75:7 states, 'It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.' This...
reflection.zh: 在政治运势的潮起潮落中，瑞典最近选举的微弱差距凸显了权力的短暂性。克里斯特松首相在所属阵营败选后辞职，提醒我们领导权最终是受托的。正如诗篇75:7所说：“唯有雅伟是审判者；他使一败涂地，使一飞冲天。”这种视角要求在胜利时保持谦卑，在失败时保持优雅，认识到更高层面的主权在起作用。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
title.zh: 加拿大欢迎欧盟成为‘联系国’的提议

summary.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has welcomed the European Union's proposal for Canada to become its first 'associate member,' emphasizing the potential for enhanced cooperation on defense, critical minerals, and energy security. Carney stated that such an alliance would serve as a 'beacon for other democracies'...
summary.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼对欧盟提议加拿大成为其首个“联系国”表示欢迎，强调了在国防、关键矿产和能源安全方面加强合作的潜力。卡尼表示，这样的联盟将在全球地缘政治动荡中成为“其他民主国家的灯塔”。该提议由欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩提出，旨在深化加拿大与欧盟之间的联系。

body.en:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has welcomed the European Union's ambition for Canada to become its first "associate member", calling for closer cooperation on defence, critical minerals and energy security.

Carney told the European Parliament in Strasbourg on Thursday that Canada and Europe were "stronger together" in the face of "geopolitical rupture".

His comments came a day after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed "opening the door" to Canada's associate membership, a status that does not currently exist.

US President Donald Trump earlier called the idea "laughable" and threatened "very serious tariffs" on Europe if he considered it a "hostile act".

Canada and the US are locked in an escalating trade dispute, with each side imposing tit-for-tat tariffs after bilateral talks collapsed last month.

"Today our societies are being battered by new storms," Carney said during his address, naming them as climate change, "the erosion of democratic norms" and the "weaponisation of trade".

"Economic integration is now being weaponised, tariffs being used to exert pressure," he said.

"Financial mechanisms have been used for coercion. Supply chains constitute weak points to be exploited."

He said a Canada-EU alliance would create a "beacon for other democracies", while stressing the two sides were not seeking to form a new power bloc.

"I am not proposing a third bloc in order to become a great-power rival - only with better manners," he told MEPs.

"This is about sovereignty, our ability to live as we wish. We do not seek power to dominate others."

Asked about the proposal on Wednesday, Trump told reporters: "If I think it's at all a hostile act, I will put very serious tariffs or stop trading with Europe, on many things.

"If it's a good intention, that's fine. If it's a bad intention, we'll put very heavy tariffs on Europe, which is a possibility."

Responding to Trump's comments at a press conference following his address, Carney said: "This alliance is a positive process, that's my response to the American president."

"Canadians are united that nobody is going to tell us what language we speak, no-one is going to dictate our culture, or with whom we can strike agreements internationally," he added.

Carney said Canada was "not in a position, nor seeking, to become a full member of the European Union", describing the proposal as a "different framework".

Speaking at the European Parliament on Wednesday, von der Leyen said she wanted Canada to become the EU's first associate member , with closer cooperation in areas such as manufacturing, technology, defence, energy critical minerals and economic security.

It is unclear exactly what that relationship would look like because the "associate member" status does not...
body.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼对欧盟让加拿大成为其第一个“准成员”的雄心表示欢迎，呼吁在国防、关键矿产和能源安全方面进行更密切的合作。 卡尼周四在斯特拉斯堡告诉欧洲议会，面对“地缘政治破裂”，加拿大和欧洲“在一起更强大”。 就在他发表此番言论的前一天，欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩提议向加拿大准会员“敞开大门”，但目前这种地位并不存在。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普早些时候称这一想法“可笑”，并威胁称，如果他认为这是“敌对行为”，将对欧洲征收“非常严重的关税”。 加拿大和美国陷入不断升级的贸易争端，上个月双边谈判破裂后，双方都针锋相对地征收关税。 卡尼在讲话中表示，“今天我们的社会正遭受新风暴的袭击”，他将其称为气候变化、“民主规范的侵蚀”和“贸易武器化”。 “经济一体化现在被武器化，关税被用来施加压力，”他说。 “金融机制被用来进行胁迫。供应链构成了可供利用的弱点。” 他表示，加拿大与欧盟的联盟将为“其他民主国家树立灯塔”，同时强调双方并不寻求形成新的权力集团。 他对欧洲议会议员表示：“我提出建立第三集团并不是为了成为大国竞争对手——只是以更好的方式。” “这关系到主权，关系到我们按照自己的意愿生活的能力。我们不寻求权力来统治他人。” 周三被问及该提议时，特朗普告诉记者：“如果我认为这完全是敌对行为，我将在很多方面征收非常严厉的关税或停止与欧洲的贸易。 “如果是善意的话，那很好。如果这是恶意的，我们将对欧洲征收非常高的关税，这是有可能的。” 卡尼在回应特朗普讲话后的新闻发布会上的评论时说：“这个联盟是一个积极的过程，这是我对美国总统的回应。” 他补充说：“加拿大人团结一致，没有人会告诉我们我们说什么语言，没有人会决定我们的文化，或者我们可以与谁达成国际协议。” 卡尼表示，加拿大“目前没有能力、也没有寻求成为欧盟的正式成员”，并将该提案描述为“不同的框架”。 冯德莱恩周三在欧洲议会发表讲话时表示，她希望加拿大成为欧盟第一个准成员，在制造、技术、国防、能源关键矿产和经济安全等领域进行更密切的合作。 目前还不清楚这种关系到底是什么样子，因为“准会员”身份并不......

reflection.en: In a world marked by 'geopolitical rupture,' Prime Minister Carney envisions a Canada-EU alliance as a 'beacon for other democracies.' This aspiration for closer cooperation, particularly in defense and security, echoes the Beatitude: 'Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of Yahweh.' The pursuit of such alliances, grounded in shared...
reflection.zh: 在一个充满“地缘政治破裂”的世界里，总理卡尼将加拿大与欧盟的联盟视为“其他民主国家的灯塔”。这种对加强合作的渴望，尤其是在国防和安全领域，呼应了那句“使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必得称为雅伟的儿子”。以共同价值观和相互支持为基础追求这样的联盟，确实能够促进一个更稳定、更有希望的全球格局。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Serbian President Vucic criticizes Kosovo war crimes verdict
title.zh: 塞尔维亚总统武契奇批评科索沃战争罪判决

summary.en: The conviction of four former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders has elicited starkly different responses across the Balkans. Serbia has voiced criticism, alleging that the court did not adequately address crimes committed against Serbs.
summary.zh: 四名前科索沃解放军领导人的定罪在巴尔干地区引发了截然不同的反应。塞尔维亚方面对此提出批评，声称法庭未能充分处理针对塞族人的罪行。

body.en:
The conviction of four former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders has drawn sharply different reactions across the Balkans. Serbia has accused the court of failing to fully address crimes against Serbs.

The Kosovo war crimes tribunal in The Hague on Wednesday  found four former leaders of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) guilty of war crimes committed during the 1998–99 Kosovo war.

The war was fought between the forces of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and Serbia , on the one side, and the KLA on the other, and took place in the context of the breakup of the former Yugoslavia.

Former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci  and former KLA leaders Kadri Veseli, Rexhep Selimi and Jakup Krasniqi were sentenced at first instance by the Kosovo Specialist Chambers to a combined 81 years in prison: Thaci and Krasniqi to 25 years each, Veseli to 18 and Selimi to 13 years.

The four men were convicted of the arbitrary detention of 385 people, cruel treatment of 49 people, torture of 303 people and the murder of 96 people.

They were acquitted of the charges of crimes against humanity on the grounds that it had not been proven that there had been a widespread or systematic attack directed against a civilian population.

Speaking at a press conference on Wednesday evening, Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic  criticized the fact that the Kosovo Specialist Chambers (which is part of Kosovo's judicial system but is based in The Hague and staffed by international judges) did not convict the four former KLA leaders of crimes against humanity.

"As a court of the so-called Kosovo , they did not want to undermine the credibility of the KLA and did not address the merits of the matter concerning the formation of forces aimed at seceding Kosovo from Serbia and the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia," he said.

Vucic added that the verdict did not cover crimes committed against Serbs after June 20, 1999, when KFOR, an international peacekeeping mission led by NATO , arrived in Kosovo after the armed conflict had officially ended.

Vucic had strong words on the reactions to the verdict from several states of the former Yugoslavia.

Commenting on Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti's assessment that the verdict represented an "unacceptable injustice," Vucic said: "Imagine if we had said that about any defendant or convicted person. How many resolutions and declarations would various European and world parliaments have adopted against our people and our country?"

This was an allusion to the condemnation by European officials of the funeral last week of former Bosnian Serb commander and convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic , which was attended by large numbers of citizens and several Serbian government ministers in Belgrade.

Vucic also commented on a...
body.zh: 四名前科索沃解放军领导人的定罪在巴尔干地区引起了截然不同的反应。塞尔维亚指责法院未能充分解决针对塞尔维亚人的犯罪问题。 周三，位于海牙的科索沃战争罪法庭裁定四名科索沃解放军 (KLA) 前领导人在 1998-99 科索沃战争期间犯有战争罪。 这场战争是在前南斯拉夫解体的背景下，一方是南斯拉夫联盟共和国和塞尔维亚军队，另一方是科索沃解放军之间进行的。 科索沃前总统哈希姆·塔奇和科索沃解放军前领导人卡德里·维塞利、雷杰普·塞利米和雅库普·克拉斯尼奇被科索沃专家分庭一审判处总共 81 年监禁：塔奇和克拉斯尼奇各 25 年，维塞利 18 年，塞利米 13 年。 这四人被判任意拘留385人、虐待49人、折磨303人以及谋杀96人。 他们被无罪释放反人类罪指控，理由是尚未证明存在针对平民的广泛或有系统的攻击。 塞尔维亚总统亚历山大·武契奇在周三晚上的新闻发布会上发表讲话，批评科索沃特别法庭（科索沃司法系统的一部分，但总部设在海牙，由国际法官组成）没有对四名前科索沃解放军领导人犯有反人类罪。 他说：“作为所谓科索沃的法院，他们不想损害科索沃解放军的信誉，也没有讨论有关组建旨在使科索沃脱离塞尔维亚和南斯拉夫联盟共和国的部队问题的实质问题。” 武契奇补充说，判决不包括1999年6月20日武装冲突正式结束后，北约领导的国际维和部队驻科部队抵达科索沃后针对塞族人犯下的罪行。 武契奇对前南斯拉夫几个国家对判决的反应发表了强硬言论。 武契奇在评论科索沃总理阿尔宾·库尔蒂关于该判决代表“不可接受的不公正”的评估时说：“想象一下，如果我们对任何被告或被定罪的人这么说。欧洲和世界议会会通过多少针对我们人民和我们国家的决议和声明？” 这是欧洲官员对上周在贝尔格莱德举行的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官、被定罪战犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇葬礼的谴责，大批公民和几位塞尔维亚政府部长参加了葬礼。 武契奇还评论了...

reflection.en: The conviction of former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders has sparked controversy, with Serbia accusing the war crimes tribunal of failing to adequately address crimes against Serbs. This highlights the deep wounds and lingering questions of justice that persist in the aftermath of conflict. The pursuit of justice is complex, and when perceived as incomplete,...
reflection.zh: 科索沃解放军前领导人的定罪引发了争议，塞尔维亚指责战争罪法庭未能充分处理针对塞族人的罪行。这凸显了冲突 aftermath 中挥之不去、伤痕累累的司法问题。伸张正义的过程是复杂的，当它被认为不完整时，可能会加剧现有的不满，阻碍和解。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: The world relies on this hidden water buffer. A ‘super’ El Niño is coming
title.zh: 世界依赖这个隐藏的水库。“超级”厄尔尼诺现象即将来临

summary.en: A decade-long decline in freshwater reserves is raising concerns about future water security, with an unprecedented El Niño expected to exacerbate the trend.
summary.zh: 淡水储备连续十年下降，引发了对未来水资源安全的担忧，而前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象预计将加剧这一趋势。

body.en:
The planet's water cycle is becoming increasingly erratic, swinging between too little and too much, the United Nations has warned, with an unprecedented El Niño expected to exacerbate the long-term trend.

Last year was among the driest for the world's rivers in over three decades, the UN's World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said in a report.

In 2025 — one of the warmest years on record — glaciers also shrank across all regions, even as groundwater levels in many parts of the world are in multi-year decline, it found.

Overall, the WMO's annual State of Global Water Resources report showed that Earth's freshwater storage — the total amount of water stored in groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, vegetation, and ice and snow — continued its decade-long decline.

Some elements of the water cycle change rapidly — like precipitation, river flow and soil moisture, responding to weather within days or weeks.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

WMO secretary-general Celeste Saulo voiced particular concern about the decline in "slow reserves", like groundwater and glaciers, which she said had traditionally served as the planet's "savings account".

They have served as "a buffer that absorbs bad years so that a single drought or a single dry season does not translate directly into a water crisis", she told reporters.

Now, "we are depleting that savings account", she warned. "We are spending our reserves."

Glaciers have also been shrinking at a precipitous rate, with 2025 marking the fourth consecutive year when they shed significant ice mass across all regions.

Between 2023 and 2025, the report estimated that glaciers lost a cumulative global glacier mass of 1,400 gigatonnes of water — roughly equal to the water required to fill 560 million Olympic-sized swimming pools, or about a third of the world's annual freshwater withdrawals.

"Groundwater tells a similar story: nearly two-thirds of monitored wells worldwide showed conditions outside the historical norm in 2025," Saulo said.

She highlighted that this was happening in parallel with "more water-related disasters".

In particular, she pointed to the current El Niño pattern, which is expected to be the strongest since comparable records began four decades ago.

El Niño is the warm phase of a natural climate cycle that occurs every two to seven years and is characterised by above-average sea surface temperatures across the Pacific, bringing worldwide changes in wind and rainfall patterns and erratic weather.

"The strengthening El Niño will increase the risk of drought in some areas, and flooding in others," Saulo...
body.zh: 联合国警告说，地球的水循环正变得越来越不稳定，在太少和太多之间摇摆，前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象预计将加剧这一长期趋势。 联合国世界气象组织（WMO）在一份报告中表示，去年是三十多年来世界河流最干旱的一年。 研究发现，2025 年是有记录以来最温暖的年份之一，尽管世界许多地区的地下水位多年来一直在下降，但所有地区的冰川都出现了萎缩。 总体而言，世界气象组织的年度全球水资源状况报告显示，地球的淡水储存量——地下水、湖泊和河流、土壤湿度、植被以及冰雪中储存的水总量——持续十年来的下降。 水循环的一些要素变化很快，比如降水、河流流量和土壤湿度，在几天或几周内就会对天气做出反应。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛对地下水和冰川等“缓慢储备”的减少表示特别担忧，她说这些传统上一直是地球的“储蓄账户”。 她告诉记者，它们起到了“吸收糟糕年份的缓冲作用，这样一次干旱或一次旱季就不会直接转化为水危机”。 她警告说，现在“我们正在耗尽储蓄账户”。 “我们正在花费我们的储备。” 冰川也在急剧萎缩，到 2025 年，所有地区的冰川将连续第四年流失。 该报告估计，2023 年至 2025 年间，全球冰川累计流失了 1,400 十亿吨水，大约相当于填满 5.6 亿个奥运会规模的游泳池所需的水，约占世界每年淡水抽取量的三分之一。 “地下水讲述了一个类似的故事：到 2025 年，全球近三分之二的监测井的状况超出了历史正常水平，”Saulo 说。 她强调，这种情况与“更多与水有关的灾难”同时发生。 她特别指出了当前的厄尔尼诺现象，预计将是自四十年前有类似记录以来最强烈的一次。 厄尔尼诺现象是自然气候周期的温暖阶段，每两到七年发生一次，其特点是太平洋海面温度高于平均水平，带来全球风和降雨模式的变化以及不稳定的天气。 “厄尔尼诺现象的加强将增加一些地区发生干旱和其他地区发生洪水的风险，”索洛...

As we face the prospect of a 'super' El Niño, the news reminds us that the Earth's resources are not ours to deplete indefinitely. Psalm 24:1 declares, 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' title.en: Ed Sheeran rarely talks politics. The Macklemore controversy has put him at the centre of it
title.zh: 埃德·希兰很少谈论政治。麦克尔莫尔的争议使他处于中心

summary.en: As artists quit Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with Macklemore, a wider debate is unfolding.
summary.zh: 随着艺术家们退出了埃德·希兰的巡演以声援麦克尔莫尔，一场更广泛的辩论正在展开。

body.en:
Ed Sheeran has built one of the world's biggest music careers while largely avoiding one of the more divisive parts of modern celebrity: politics.

The English singer has spoken publicly about some causes over the years, including performing at a major benefit concert for Ukraine following Russia's 2022 invasion. But he has generally resisted using his concerts as a political platform, something he says is deliberate.

Now, Macklemore's removal from his United States tour has drawn Sheeran into a political debate he has largely sought to avoid.

In less than two weeks, Macklemore has made a high-profile pro-Palestinian speech while opening for Sheeran, been removed from his remaining US tour dates, and been followed out the door by four other acts.

Sheeran has insisted the decision to remove the American rapper wasn't his and says he spent days trying to prevent it.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But the fallout has nevertheless dragged the 35-year-old singer into a highly charged debate over the Israel-Gaza conflict, antisemitism and the role, or responsibility, of artists to use their platforms to take a political stand.

And it has forced Sheeran to publicly explain why, unlike Macklemore, he generally chooses not to.

"I have my personal views on this devastating conflict," Sheeran wrote in a lengthy statement posted to Instagram this week.

"Just because I choose not to speak publicly, it doesn't mean I don't have them, and it doesn't mean I don't care."

The dispute began on 4 September, when Macklemore was performing as a support act on Sheeran's Loop Tour at a New Jersey stadium.

Introducing his 2024 protest song Hind's Hall, the rapper told the crowd that part of the reason he wanted to join the tour was to use its enormous stadium audiences to amplify his support for Palestinians.

"A big part of the reason why I wanted to do this tour in the first place is so I could stand up in stadiums like this and say two words that are very near and dear to my heart: 'Free Palestine'," Macklemore said.

The following day, he again addressed the conflict, telling Jewish members of the audience that his criticism of Israel was not criticism of them.

The remarks sparked a backlash, with the Israeli-American Council launching a petition calling for Macklemore to be removed from the tour, arguing Sheeran's stage should not be used for "one-sided political propaganda".

By Monday, he was off the tour. Promoter Messina Touring Group said venue owners hosting upcoming dates had indicated they would not allow shows featuring Macklemore to proceed.

The episode has highlighted the starkly different approaches the two artists take to their public...
body.zh: 艾德·希兰 (Ed Sheeran) 建立了世界上最大的音乐事业之一，同时在很大程度上避开了现代名人中最具争议性的部分之一：政治。 这位英国歌手多年来曾公开谈论过一些原因，包括在俄罗斯 2022 年入侵后为乌克兰举办的一场大型慈善音乐会上表演。但他总体上拒绝将音乐会作为政治平台，他说这是故意的。 现在，麦克莫尔被取消美国之行，这让希兰陷入了一场他在很大程度上试图避免的政治辩论。 在不到两周的时间里，麦克莫尔在为希兰开场时发表了高调的亲巴勒斯坦演讲，被从他剩余的美国巡演日期中删除，并被其他四位表演者追随出局。 希兰坚称，解雇这位美国说唱歌手的决定不是他自己做出的，并表示他花了几天时间试图阻止这一决定。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但此事的后果却让这位 35 岁的歌手卷入了一场关于以色列-加沙冲突、反犹太主义以及艺术家利用自己的平台表明政治立场的角色或责任的激烈辩论。 这迫使希兰公开解释为什么与麦克莫尔不同，他通常选择不这样做。 “我对这场毁灭性的冲突有我个人的看法，”希兰在本周发布在 Instagram 上的一份长篇声明中写道。 “仅仅因为我选择不公开发言，并不意味着我没有它们，也不意味着我不在乎。” 这场纠纷始于 9 月 4 日，当时 Macklemore 在新泽西州体育场为 Sheeran's Loop Tour 表演助兴表演。 这位说唱歌手在介绍他的 2024 年抗议歌曲《Hind's Hall》时告诉观众，他想参加巡演的部分原因是利用体育场庞大的观众来扩大他对巴勒斯坦人的支持。 麦克勒莫尔说：“我最初想要参加这次巡演的一个重要原因是，我可以站在这样的体育场里，说出两个我心目中非常亲近的词：‘自由巴勒斯坦’。” 第二天，他再次谈到了这场冲突，告诉观众中的犹太成员，他对以色列的批评并不是对他们的批评。 这一言论引发了强烈反对，以色列-美国委员会发起请愿书，要求将麦克勒莫从巡演中除名，并认为希兰的舞台不应被用于“单方面的政治宣传”。 到了周一，他就退出了巡演。发起人 Messina Touring Group 表示，举办即将举行的演出的场地所有者已表示，他们不会允许麦克莫尔的演出继续进行。 这一集凸显了两位艺术家对公众采取的截然不同的方式......

reflection.en: Ed Sheeran has built a career on largely avoiding political statements, a deliberate choice to sidestep divisive issues. However, the controversy surrounding Macklemore's pro-Palestinian speech has unexpectedly placed Sheeran at the center of a political debate he sought to avoid. This situation highlights how even attempts to remain neutral can draw...
reflection.zh: 埃德·希兰的职业生涯很大程度上建立在避免政治表态之上，这是他刻意选择避开争议性问题的做法。然而，围绕麦克尔莫尔亲巴勒斯坦演讲的争议却出人意料地将希兰置于他试图回避的政治辩论的中心。这种情况凸显了即使是试图保持中立，也可能将个人卷入公众的争论之中，尤其是在个人信念与公众平台交织在一起时。

title.en: Why this tiny English village voted to 'secede' from the UK
title.zh: 为何这个微小的英国村庄投票“脱离”英国

summary.en: Residents of a small English village have voted to leave the UK in a symbolic independence referendum, protesting plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.
summary.zh: 英国一个小村庄的居民在一场象征性的独立公投中投票决定脱离英国，以抗议在附近设施安置超过1200名移民的计划。

body.en:
An English village of around 350 people announced overnight that a vast majority of residents had voted to exit the United Kingdom in an "independence referendum" in protest at plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.

Piddington in central England, 25 kilometres from the university city of Oxford, has grabbed headlines with its tongue-in-cheek breakaway vote.

The village's parish council announced that with 312 ballots counted, 285 had voted to secede from Britain over plans to house asylum seekers in a nearby disused military site, in a symbolic vote with no recognised legal basis.

Residents were handed a ballot paper with the statement: "I support Piddington seeking to secede from the United Kingdom and pursuing self-determination."

The local parish council chair Tim McNally said that the village will now be known as the "principality of Piddington".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

McNally told UK broadcaster Sky News: "For us, it's about proportionality — how does a small village of 350 odd people assimilate with 1,250 males?"

The leader of Oxfordshire county council Tim Bearder, speaking to the BBC, warned the planned centre "will be a lightning rod to the far right, who come here to protest" and "potentially attack" asylum seekers.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham promised to "look at the issues raised by the community and in the referendum" but said the "vast majority" of British people backed a government plan to stop housing asylum seekers in hotels and it was "fair" to locate holding centres around the country.

UK culture secretary Lisa Nandy told the BBC a former military base "is a better option for housing asylum seekers" than hotels or rented accommodation and vowed the base would go ahead.

Around Britain, regular protests have been staged against housing asylum seekers in hotels and other facilities.

Supporters called the declaration of independence a victory for people power and local democracy. Some media coverage compared the gesture to the comedy film Passport to Pimlico.

In the 1949 classic, a small group of Londoners discover treasure and declare independence making them exempt from post-war rationing and other bureaucratic restrictions.

Others said the campaign had a darker side and stirred up fear of newcomers. Some backers of the Piddington referendum compared their fight against the asylum accommodation to the 1940 Battle of Britain against Nazi Germany.

Villager Herbert Owen, 76, said after voting that the independence referendum "isn’t just about Piddington," adding: "It means everything our grandparents, our parents fought for. Today is the Battle of Britain."

It argues this is a dereliction of duty that increases AI risks. Prominent AI CEOs like Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Dario Amodei have called for a slowdown due...

body.en: Trump and Republicans want companies to regulate themselves. It’s a dereliction of duty that will make AI less safe It is hard to get Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Dario Amodei to agree on much. But over the weekend, all three AI company CEOs called for AI development to slow down in the face of growing, alarming risks. Their employees are sounding the siren too, with one researcher publicly quitting and accusing OpenAI and Anthropic of “gambling with our lives”. The combination of dire warnings from insiders and growing real-world evidence of rogue AIs should, in a sane world, lead to government action. Instead, Donald Trump and the Republican leadership have their heads in the sand. Continue reading...

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.
