body.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器，这是在警告俄罗斯等国家可能将长期在条约中达成的仅用于和平目的的全球前沿武器化之后，这是一个引人注目的启示。 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国已经部署了“能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动攻击的在轨太空控制武器”。 梅克没有详细说明这些武器是什么、它们如何工作，或者它们是否针对太空或地球上的其他物体。 美国两年前曾警告称，俄罗斯正在开发一种新的天基反卫星武器，尽管白宫当时表示危险并未迫在眉睫。 但有关反卫星武器的报道反映了人们长期以来对俄罗斯和中国太空威胁的担忧，因为美国的大部分基础设施都依赖于卫星通信。美国此前也展示了自己从地球击落卫星的能力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅克在澳大利亚东部标准时间周二举行的美国空军协会航空、航天和网络会议上发表讲话时还表示，空军正在为其能力添加更多自主系统，并预测到 2032 年该军种将“截然不同”。 例如，他预见单向攻击无人机将取代火炮成为“主要杀手”。 分析人士表示，美国的披露证实了一个公开的秘密，但公布的时机可能会加剧与中国的紧张关系以及太空武器竞赛的风险。 2019 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其第一任期内创建了太空军，作为一个独立的军事部门。在他的第二个任期内，他宣布了金顶导弹防御系统，其中包括将美国武器部署到太空的计划。 特朗普去年表示，他预计该系统将“在我的任期结束前全面投入运行”，任期将于 2029 年 1 月结束。 他表示，该系统将具有拦截导弹的能力，“即使它们是从太空发射的”。 特朗普还在就任总统的第一周内发布行政命令，指示五角大楼追捕天基拦截器。 国会预算办公室估计，未来 20 年，仅金顶的太空部分就可能花费高达 5,420 亿美元（7,600 亿美元）。 对于美国来说，俄罗斯和中国这两个主要的地缘政治对手都对美国的太空利益构成潜在威胁。 美国太空军表示，中国“发展和运营太空和反太空能力，作为军事现代化战略的一部分”。 与此同时，俄罗斯“将太空视为......

reflection.en: The ancient prophetic vision of Isaiah, that nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares,' speaks to our deepest hopes for peace. Yet, the news of weapons being deployed in space, a frontier long envisioned for peaceful exploration, raises concerns about a new arms race. May wisdom guide nations to prioritize cooperation and shared stewardship of this...
reflection.zh: 以赛亚先知古老的预言，即列国将“把刀打成犁头”，触及我们对和平最深切的盼望。然而，太空这一曾被设想为和平探索之地的疆域，如今却传出部署武器的消息，这引发了对新军备竞赛的担忧。愿智慧引导列国，在广阔的太空疆域上，优先考虑合作与共同管理，而非冲突。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们对让人想起詹姆斯·乔伊斯散文的人工智能术语表示担忧，这给监控和监督带来了麻烦。新的研究发现，人工智能模型已经开始用一种奇怪的新英语版本进行交流，这种英语读起来像是詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《芬尼根守灵夜》和科技兄弟行话的混合体。自主人工智能代理正在迅速创造新的方言，使他们能够用一种通常难以理解的语言进行交谈，这可能会让人类更难监控他们的行为。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of AI communication, creating 'surreal' dialects, highlights a growing gap between human understanding and machine intelligence. As knowledge and complexity increase, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to seek wisdom and discernment to navigate these new frontiers, ensuring our oversight remains effective.
reflection.zh: 人工智能交流的快速发展，创造出“超现实”的方言，凸显了人类理解与机器智能之间日益扩大的差距。正如但以理书12:4所述，随着知识和复杂性的增加，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，以驾驭这些新领域，确保我们的监督保持有效。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: US confirms for first time it has deployed weapons in space
title.zh: 美国首次确认已部署太空武器

summary.en: The US military has confirmed the deployment of weapons in space, a move that analysts warn could escalate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth's orbit. The confirmation comes from the US Air Force Secretary, who stated that "on-orbit" weapons are now active and circling the globe.
summary.zh: 美国军方已确认在太空部署了武器，分析人士警告此举可能加剧与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长证实了这一消息，并表示“在轨”武器已处于活动状态并绕地球运行。

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析人士警告称，与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛将加速美国军方在一份非同寻常的公开声明中证实，美国已在太空部署武器，分析人士警告称，这将加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克表示，华盛顿拥有活跃的“在轨”武器，这意味着它们已经部署并正在环绕地球飞行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The confirmation of weapons in space is a sobering development, highlighting humanity's persistent drive to weaponize new frontiers. Isaiah's vision of a world where nations 'beat their swords into plowshares' offers a stark contrast to this trajectory. May we pray for wisdom and restraint among global powers, that the pursuit of security does not lead to...
reflection.zh: 在太空部署武器的确认是一个令人警醒的发展，凸显了人类将新领域武器化的持续驱动力。以赛亚关于世界各国“将刀打成犁头”的异象与这一轨迹形成了鲜明对比。愿我们为全球大国祈求智慧和克制，使对安全的追求不至于导致相互毁灭。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。珍妮弗·卡瓦纳（Jennifer Kavanagh）在偏右的国防优先基金会（Defense Priorities...

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，因间谍头子警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: Beijing has responded to calls for the US to hinder China's AI industry, dismissing them as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief expressed concerns that the advancement of artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the rule of the Communist party.
summary.zh: 北京方面驳斥了要求美国阻碍中国人工智能产业发展的呼吁，称其为‘危言耸听’。与此同时，中国最高情报官员警告称，人工智能的不断发展可能威胁到共产党统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented capabilities, prompting both excitement and apprehension. As nations and leaders grapple with its potential, the ancient story of Babel reminds us that unchecked ambition, even in pursuit of knowledge or power, can lead to unintended consequences and division.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的能力，既引发了兴奋，也带来了忧虑。当国家和领导人都在努力应对其潜力时，古老的巴别塔故事提醒我们，即使是在追求知识或权力的过程中，不受约束的野心也可能导致意想不到的后果和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Europe must build own AI or risk getting cut off by US or China, says ECB’s Lagarde
title.zh: 欧洲央行行长：欧洲必须发展自己的人工智能，否则将面临被美国或中国切断联系的风险

summary.en: Christine Lagarde, president of the European Central Bank, has urged Europe to develop its own artificial intelligence (AI) technology and build more domestic data centers. She warned that the continent's current dependency on AI could give trade partners like the US or China unprecedented leverage, potentially...
summary.zh: 欧洲中央银行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德敦促欧洲发展自己的人工智能（AI）技术并建立更多国内数据中心。她警告说，该大陆目前对人工智能的依赖可能会使美国或中国等贸易伙伴获得前所未有的影响力，并可能导致欧洲被切断与这些技术的联系。

body.en: Central bank chief says continent’s AI dependency could give trade partners unprecedented leverage in negotiations Europe must develop its own AI technology and build more datacentres in order to nullify the threat of being cut off by the US or China, according to the president of the European Central Bank. Christine Lagarde said the continent needed AI models – the technology that powers AI tools such as chatbots – that were “good enough” to carry out most tasks and run from domestic datacentres. If Europe invests in its own AI tech, said Lagarde, “the threat of being cut off loses its force”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧洲央行行长表示，欧洲大陆对人工智能的依赖可能会给贸易伙伴在谈判中带来前所未有的影响力，欧洲必须开发自己的人工智能技术并建立更多的数据中心，以消除被美国或中国切断联系的威胁。克里斯蒂娜·拉加德表示，非洲大陆需要人工智能模型——为聊天机器人等人工智能工具提供动力的技术——“足够好”来执行大多数任务并在国内数据中心运行。拉加德表示，如果欧洲投资自己的人工智能技术，“被切断的威胁就会失去力量”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ambition to create powerful AI, as discussed by ECB President Lagarde, mirrors the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's drive for unified, unchecked technological advancement can lead to unintended consequences, scattering efforts and creating new forms of division. True wisdom lies not just in capability, but in discerning the right path and purpose for...
reflection.zh: 欧洲央行行长拉加德所讨论的创造强大人工智能的雄心，与古代巴别塔的故事如出一辙。人类追求统一的、不受约束的技术进步的驱动力可能导致意想不到的后果，分散努力并制造新的分裂形式。真正的智慧不仅在于能力，还在于辨别我们创造物的正确道路和目的。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: Artists boycotted this portrait prize over AI entries. Now they’re back to take them on
title.zh: 艺术家抵制AI参赛作品的肖像奖，现又回来与其竞争

summary.en: After boycotting the Brisbane portrait prize for two years due to AI-generated entries, several artists, including First Nations painters, are now re-entering. They plan to leverage 'ancestral integrity' as a counter-strategy against AI, aiming to win the competition.
summary.zh: 在因人工智能生成的参赛作品而抵制布里斯班肖像奖两年后，包括第一民族画家在内的几位艺术家正在重新参赛。他们计划利用“祖传的完整性”作为对抗人工智能的策略，以期赢得比赛。

body.en: After two years shunning the Brisbane portrait prize, several artists are entering again, with some First Nations painters counting on another AI – ‘ancestral integrity’ – to help them win Poised above the lady in the red dress is a claw. Its metallic fingers grasp to pluck its prize from a jumble of other women while she looks dreamily upward, as if to say “Who, me?” The woman in the red dress is Australian comedian Alice Fraser , as photographed on stage. The other women – generic superheroes and 1950s housewives – were created using the generative AI software Krea. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在回避布里斯班肖像奖两年后，几位艺术家再次参赛，一些原住民画家指望另一种人工智能——“祖先的完整性”——来帮助他们赢得胜利。它的金属手指紧紧抓住，从一堆其他女人中夺取奖品，而她则梦幻般地向上看，仿佛在说“谁，我？”舞台上拍摄的穿红裙子的女人是澳大利亚喜剧演员爱丽丝·弗雷泽。其他女性——普通超级英雄和 20 世纪 50 年代的家庭主妇——是使用生成人工智能软件 Krea 创建的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tension between human artistry and artificial intelligence in the Brisbane portrait prize raises questions about creativity and value. The artists' reliance on 'ancestral integrity' points to a deeper human source of meaning and worth, reminding us that we are all created in the image of Yahweh, possessing a unique dignity that technology cannot...
reflection.zh: 布里斯班肖像奖中人类艺术与人工智能之间的紧张关系，引发了关于创造力和价值的疑问。艺术家们对“祖传的完整性”的依赖，指向了更深层次的人类意义和价值来源，提醒我们，我们都是按照雅伟的形象被创造的，拥有技术无法复制的独特尊严。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Australians with big mortgages are stressed out – and the mental health toll is heavy
title.zh: 抵押贷款压力沉重，澳大利亚人的心理健康受到严重影响

summary.en: Australians with large mortgages are experiencing significant stress and anxiety due to financial pressures, with rising interest rates exacerbating the burden. For individuals like Emily Knights, who is solely responsible for her mortgage after a relationship ended, the financial strain is taking a heavy toll on her...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚背负巨额抵押贷款的民众正因财务压力而承受着巨大的压力和焦虑，不断上升的利率加剧了负担。对于像艾米丽·奈特斯（Emily Knights）这样在关系结束后独自承担抵押贷款的人来说，财务负担正严重影响着她的心理健康。

body.en: Mortgage holders like Emily Knights say financial pressure is causing serious anxiety, as a study reveals the effects of debt stress and rising rates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When Emily Knights bought a quaint two-bedroom starter home with her then-partner in Geelong, Victoria, the milestone marked years of financial sacrifice. However, the end of their relationship shortly afterwards left her shouldering the entire mortgage on a home that needed renovation and had “no working oven”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 艾米莉·奈茨 (Emily Knights) 等抵押贷款持有人表示，财务压力正在引发严重焦虑，因为一项研究揭示了债务压力和利率上升的影响。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当艾米莉·奈茨 (Emily Knights) 与她当时的伴侣在维多利亚州吉朗购买了一套古色古香的两居室入门住宅时，这一里程碑标志着多年来的财务牺牲。然而，不久之后他们的关系就结束了，她承担了一套需要装修且“没有烤箱”的房屋的全部抵押贷款。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The weight of debt can feel crushing, especially when life circumstances change unexpectedly. Proverbs 22:7 reminds us that debt creates a form of bondage, a reality Emily Knights is experiencing as she navigates her mortgage alone. May we find wisdom and resilience in managing our finances and support those struggling under its burden.
reflection.zh: 债务的重担有时会让人感到不堪重负，尤其是在生活境况发生意外变化时。《箴言》22:7 提醒我们，债务会造成一种束缚，这正是艾米丽·奈特斯独自面对抵押贷款时所经历的现实。愿我们在管理财务时找到智慧和韧性，并支持那些在债务重压下挣扎的人们。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: Alan Jones on Trial: A prominent athlete takes the stand | Week 7 – podcast
title.zh: 艾伦·琼斯庭审：一位知名运动员出庭作证 | 第7周 – 播客

summary.en: For the first time, seven weeks into the criminal trial of Alan Jones, a complainant came face-to-face with his alleged offender in the courtroom. The former athlete, known as complainant M, was the third of six complainants and chose to give evidence in the same room as Jones. The courtroom heard allegations that...
summary.zh: 庭审进行到第七周，艾伦·琼斯（Alan Jones）的案子中，一位原告首次与被指控的施害者在法庭上正面相对。这位被称为原告M的前运动员是六名原告中的第三位，他选择在琼斯所在的同一个房间里作证。法庭听到了琼斯被指控两次未经同意亲吻这位知名运动员的指控。

body.en: For the first time, seven weeks into the criminal trial of Alan Jones, a complainant came face-to-face with his alleged offender in the courtroom. The former athlete, known as complainant M, was the third of six complainants and chose to give evidence in the same room as Jones. The courtroom – and the journalists squeezed into a separate room in the court – heard allegations against Jones that he twice kissed the prominent athlete without consent Prominent athlete tells Alan Jones trial he sent shirtless photo before unwanted kiss he wished ‘never happened’ Continue reading...
body.zh: 在艾伦·琼斯刑事审判七周后，申诉人第一次在法庭上与他所指控的罪犯面对面。这位被称为申诉人 M 的前运动员是六名申诉人中的第三个，他选择与琼斯在同一房间提供证据。法庭上——记者们挤在法庭的一个单独的房间里——听取了对琼斯的指控，称他在未经同意的情况下两次亲吻了这位著名运动员。著名运动员告诉艾伦·琼斯审判，他在不想要的亲吻之前发送了赤裸上身的照片，他希望“从未发生过”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In this trial, complainant M bravely faced his alleged abuser, choosing to speak his truth in the same room. This act of courage, bearing witness to harm and seeking accountability, echoes the biblical call to defend the oppressed and speak for those who have been wronged. It is a difficult but necessary step toward justice.
reflection.zh: 在这场庭审中，原告M勇敢地面对了他所指控的施害者，选择在同一个房间里说出他的真相。这种勇敢的行为，为所遭受的伤害作证并寻求问责，呼应了圣经中为受压迫者辩护、为受屈者发声的呼召。这是迈向正义之路上一段艰难但必要的旅程。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.

title.en: Veterans relieved as Labor backs down on plan to limit health payments
title.zh: 退伍军人对工党放弃限制医疗付款计划感到宽慰

summary.en: The government has abandoned plans to cap veterans' allied health payments at $5,000 annually, following significant criticism from veterans, politicians, and advocates. This decision reverses a measure intended to save money but which drew widespread condemnation.
summary.zh: 在退伍军人、政界人士和倡导者提出大量批评后，政府已放弃了将退伍军人附属医疗付款上限设为每年5000澳元的计划。这一决定推翻了一项旨在节省资金但遭到广泛谴责的措施。

body.en:
Labor has dumped controversial plans for a $5,000 cap on veterans' allied health payments as part of its "solemn obligation" to ex-serving personnel.

Following sustained criticism and campaigning from advocates, Veterans' Affairs Minister Matt Keogh announced on Thursday the government had backed down on the measure.

In a bid to improve the budget's bottom line, the government introduced a $5,000 annual limit on allied health services for veterans which was originally set to come into effect from July 2027.

This would have resulted in cutting more than $779 million over the next four years from the portfolio.

The proposal attracted widespread condemnation, with the coalition, Greens and crossbench all calling for Labor to dump the cap.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Keogh said the government took its "solemn obligation" to veterans very seriously.

"We brought forward a package of measures to improve access to allied health, improving the fees paid to allied health practitioners, so that they would provide better service to our veteran community," he told parliament.

"And as part of that, we also committed and did engage with the ex-service organisations, with veterans, with families ... and we committed to listen, and we did, and we heard, and we have responded."

Keogh has faced calls in recent weeks to resign after he initially declined to meet with advocates over the cap.

The government was criticised after the parents of Cameron Baird, who was killed in 2013 during a deployment to Afghanistan, were told their travel allowance would be cut.

Fair Care for Veterans spokesman John Armfield, a former Navy clearance diver, thanked Mr Keogh for dumping the cap.

"The minister says he wants to keep talking to veterans and providers. We welcome that, and we'll be there.

"We'll also make sure whatever comes next doesn't bring the cap back under another name."

Veteran and Tasmanian senator Jacqui Lambie, alongside Greens senator David Shoebridge, successfully passed a bill in the upper house to stop any future cap being imposed on health payments.

Lambie, who gave an emotional address about the healthcare barriers facing female veterans, hailed the win.

She urged veterans not to take out their anger on Keogh or the department, noting the work completed on implementing key reforms from the Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide.

"I have seen more movement in the last two years since that Royal Commission than what I have in the whole 10 years I've bloody been up here," Lambie told reporters.

"They are working hard, and there will be slips along the way, and that is my job to represent you guys up here."

Shoebridge said there...

title.en: 'Absurd': Yoga teachers become an unlikely flashpoint in Australia's migration debate
title.zh: “荒谬”：瑜伽老师成为澳大利亚移民辩论中一个不太可能的焦点

summary.en: The Australian government has faced persistent political criticism regarding its immigration policies, specifically accusations that it prioritizes admitting yoga instructors over much-needed construction workers to address a housing shortage. This political line of attack, originating from media reports, claims that...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政府因其移民政策而面临持续的政治批评，特别是被指责优先引进瑜伽教练而非急需的建筑工人来解决住房短缺问题。这种政治攻击的说法源于媒体报道，声称瑜伽和武术教练在签证队列中被排在技工之前。

body.en:
Amid an ongoing political battle over which party's at fault for a lack of housing and migration numbers, an unlikely target has emerged: yoga teachers.

Labor has been accused by the Opposition of prioritising bringing in instructors of the flexible exercise to Australia, over construction workers sorely needed to address a critical housing shortage.

The Coalition since 2024 has levelled claims against Labor of putting instructors for martial arts and yoga ahead of tradies like bricklayers, painters, roof tilers and stonemasons in the visa queue.

The origins of the political line of attack appeared to come from a Nine Newspaper report which said in 2024 that a federal agency, Jobs and Skills Australia, listed yoga teachers as a skill in demand. Former coalition MP Michael Sukkar highlighted the report on social media, saying: "Under Labor they'll be more Yoga teachers and less tradies!".

On Thursday, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke sought to put the claims to bed, once and for all.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It is absurd," he told the National Press Club, saying it was among the "silliest of all" arguments.

Burke outlined that rather than deprioritising construction workers, the government had tripled the number it was bringing in, from 4,500 to 15,000.

"In the life of this government, the number of yoga teachers we have brought in is zero," he said.

According to a fact check from Australian Associated Press (AAP) newswire, the opposition housing spokesman Andrew Bragg and colleagues made the claim a number of times in the past year, saying the government was bringing in more yoga teachers than construction workers.

AAP checked the claim against figures from the Department of Home Affairs, finding that only four yoga instructors have arrived since July 1, 2022, compared to thousands of construction workers that have come to Australia on skilled visas.

"While this figure may include yoga teachers, it could also cover coaches of other sports such as basketball or cricket," it said in an August finding.

Yoga teachers came under the temporary skilled visa program in 2022 after the Morrison government signed a trade agreement with India. The places are reserved for Indian nationals under that deal.

"It's a tiny argument, but it is so constantly out there and so demonstrably wrong, it gives an indication as to how a debate like this can just run out of control," Burke said.

body.zh: 在一场关于哪一方应因缺乏住房和移民人数的过错而进行的政治斗争中，一个不太可能的目标出现了：瑜伽老师。 反对党指责工党优先考虑将灵活练习的讲师引入澳大利亚，而不是解决严重的住房短缺问题所急需的建筑工人。 自2024年以来，联盟党一直对工党提出指控，称工党将武术和瑜伽教练置于签证队列中，排在瓦匠、油漆工、屋顶瓦工和石匠等技工之前。 政治攻击路线的起源似乎来​​自九号报纸的一篇报道，该报道称，2024 年，联邦机构澳大利亚就业和技能局将瑜伽教师列为一项紧缺技能。前联盟议员迈克尔·苏卡在社交媒体上强调了这一报道，他说：“在工党的领导下，他们将更多地担任瑜伽老师，而不是技工！”。 周四，内政部长托尼·伯克试图一劳永逸地平息这些说法。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这是荒谬的，”他告诉国家新闻俱乐部，并称这是“最愚蠢的”论点之一。 伯克概述说，政府并没有降低建筑工人的优先级，而是将引进的人数增加了两倍，从 4,500 人增加到 15,000 人。 “在本届政府任期内，我们引进的瑜伽老师数量为零，”他说。 据澳大利亚美联社（AAP）新闻专线的事实调查显示，反对党住房发言人安德鲁·布拉格（Andrew Bragg）及其同事在过去一年多次提出这一说法，称政府引进的瑜伽老师比建筑工人还多。 AAP 对照内政部的数据核实了这一说法，发现自 2022 年 7 月 1 日以来，只有四名瑜伽教练抵达澳大利亚，而有数千名持技术签证来到澳大利亚的建筑工人。 “虽然这个数字可能包括瑜伽老师，但也可能包括篮球或板球等其他运动的教练，”它在八月份的调查结果中表示。 莫里森政府与印度签署贸易协议后，瑜伽教师于 2022 年获得临时技术签证计划。根据该协议，这些席位是为印度国民保留的。 伯克说：“这是一个微小的争论，但它总是存在，而且明显是错误的，它表明像这样的辩论如何会失控。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Cuts, punishment powers and a notable exception: Key changes in Labor's migration shake-up
title.zh: 削减、惩罚权和例外：工党移民改革的关键变化

summary.en: The federal government has announced a shake-up of Australia's migration system, targeting visa-hoppers, overstayers, students, and backpackers. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke unveiled the changes, stating the reforms aim to bring migration back in line with targets and assist housing supply.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联邦政府宣布将对其移民系统进行重大调整，重点打击签证欺诈者、逾期逗留者、学生和背包客。内政部长托尼·伯克公布了这些改革措施，并表示这些改革旨在使移民人数回到政府目标范围内，并帮助解决住房供应问题。

body.en:
The federal government has announced a shake-up of Australia's migration system, with visa-hoppers, overstayers, students, and backpackers targeted in the crackdown.

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke unveiled the changes during a National Press Club address on Thursday , following weeks of delay, heated debate and speculation.

Burke began his speech by highlighting the contribution of migration to Australia, but acknowledging there were problems with the current policy settings.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Burke said the reforms are split into three parts: who arrives, who stays and who leaves.

Among the most consequential changes are those affecting students, backpackers, visa overstayers and visa hoppers.

International students and those on graduate visas will no longer be able to bring family members with them to Australia, with some exceptions for PhD students and some Pacific and ASEAN students.

As part of a so-called "visa-hopping" crackdown, Burke said the government will introduce a qualification scale, meaning only foreign students transferring to higher-level courses (bachelor's to master's for example) will be able to extend their visas.

A ballot system and cap will be introduced for backpackers wishing to extend their visit to a second or third year.

Only 45,000 working holiday-makers will be able to stay in Australia for a second year, and only 5,000 for a third year — down from 57,000 and 31,000 respectively. This will not affect United Kingdom citizens under the rules of a free trade agreement.

The government has already slowed down the processing of working holiday visas, with applications now taking months to be approved. Burke said processing of second-and third-year visas will be restored to the previous, faster pace — with the exception of UK citizens, who are exempt from regional work requirements to secure a visa extension.

The number of UK backpackers has risen sharply since the free trade agreement came into effect in 2023, from about 17,000 in 2021 to just under 80,000 now.

People who overstay their visas, of whom there are about 77,000, will face tougher sanctions, including detention. The government is now looking for more facilities, compliance officers and beds.

Burke said this was a return to a pre-2015 model, when visa overstayers would be taken into detention, and within a few weeks, organise their own flight and leave.

However, he said it would not involve "the sort of operation that some people have seen on TV happening in other countries", an apparent reference to the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations, which have involved mass deportation operations, arrests, and...
body.zh: 联邦政府宣布对澳大利亚的移民制度进行重组，签证跳跃者、逾期居留者、学生和背包客成为打击对象。 经过数周的拖延、激烈的辩论和猜测后，内政部长托尼·伯克周四在全国新闻俱乐部的讲话中公布了这些变化。 伯克在演讲开始时强调了移民对澳大利亚的贡献，但也承认当前的政策设置存在问题。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 伯克表示，改革分为三个部分：谁来、谁留下、谁离开。 其中最重要的变化是影响学生、背包客、签证逾期居留者和签证跳跃者的变化。 国际学生和持有研究生签证的学生将不再能够携带家庭成员来澳大利亚，但博士生以及一些太平洋和东盟学生除外。 伯克表示，作为所谓“跳签证”打击的一部分，政府将引入资格等级，这意味着只有转学到更高级别课程（例如从学士到硕士）的外国学生才能延长签证。 对于希望将访问时间延长到第二年或第三年的背包客，将为他们引入抽签制度和上限。 只有 45,000 名打工度假者能够第二年留在澳大利亚，第三年只有 5,000 人——分别低于 57,000 人和 31,000 人。根据自由贸易协定的规则，这不会影响英国公民。 政府已经放慢了打工度假签证的处理速度，申请现在需要几个月才能获得批准。伯克表示，第二年和第三年签证的处理将恢复到以前的更快速度，但英国公民除外，他们可以免除获得签证延期的地区工作要求。 自2023年自由贸易协定生效以来，英国背包客数量大幅增加，从2021年的约17,000人增加到现在的近80,000人。 签证逾期居留的人约有 77,000 人，将面临更严厉的制裁，包括拘留。政府目前正在寻找更多设施、合规官员和床位。 伯克表示，这是对 2015 年之前模式的回归，当时签证逾期居留者将被拘留，并在几周内组织自己的航班并离开。 不过，他表示，这不会涉及“一些人在电视上看到的其他国家发生的那种行动”，这显然是指美国移民和海关执法局的行动，其中涉及大规模驱逐行动、逮捕和……

reflection.en: Governments bear the weighty responsibility of managing their nations, balancing the needs of citizens with the influx of newcomers. The reforms announced in Australia aim to bring migration numbers in line with national targets, a complex task that requires careful stewardship of resources and a vision for the nation's future. May leaders always seek...
reflection.zh: 政府肩负着管理国家的重任，需要在本国公民的需求与新移民的涌入之间取得平衡。澳大利亚宣布的改革旨在使移民人数符合国家目标，这是一项复杂的任务，需要审慎地管理资源并为国家的未来制定愿景。 愿领导者在决策时始终寻求智慧与公正，确保政策能服务于公共利益，并维护所有人的尊严，包括已有的居民和那些寻求新家园的人们。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: From 'cashies' to convictions: The ATO's $2.7 million warning shot
title.zh: 从“现金交易”到定罪：税务局的270万澳元警告

summary.en: The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) is prosecuting hundreds of individuals and businesses for tax offenses, collecting millions in fines as part of a crackdown on the 'shadow economy,' which includes practices like demanding cash payments to avoid tax. Prosecutions for non-lodgment have increased by 80% in two years.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚税务局（ATO）正在起诉数百名个人和企业逃税，并追缴数百万澳元的罚款，这是其打击“影子经济”的一部分，其中包括要求现金支付以避税等行为。两年内，未申报的起诉案件增加了80%。

body.en:
Hundreds of people and businesses have been prosecuted for tax offences, with millions of dollars in fines handed down as authorities crack down on the shadow economy.

The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) on Thursday revealed non-lodgment prosecutions against "dodgy shadow economy operators" had risen by 80 per cent over the past two years, as it warned those who broke the rules would be held accountable.

The shadow economy involves both legal and illegal economic activity, including demanding cash payments for work, known as "cashies", to avoid tax, and underpayment of entitlements such as superannuation.

The ATO said more than 350 individuals or businesses had been successfully prosecuted in the past two years, resulting in more than $2.7 million in fines.

In the 2025-26 financial year, Queensland accounted for 28 per cent of non-lodgment prosecutions, followed by Western Australia (26 per cent) and NSW (20 per cent).

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

ATO assistant commissioner Tony Goding said avoiding tax and super obligations was seen by some as a victimless crime, but came at a cost to the community.

"The shadow economy undermines legitimate businesses and reduces revenue that would otherwise fund essential public services that support all Australians," he said.

"It doesn't matter what profession you're in, if you're a tradie, hairdresser or cafe owner, and you deliberately avoid paying the right amount of tax, you risk more than financial penalties."

Of the prosecutions, more than 305 resulted in convictions, representing a nearly 60 per cent increase from 2024–25 and 2025–26 financial years.

Goding said the figures demonstrated the ATO was holding those who break the rules to account.

"People who deliberately break the law risk their reputation and future, and the impact of a criminal conviction extends beyond the courtroom," he said.

"We've seen business owners receive criminal convictions, lose the trust of their customers and community, and in some cases, lose the very business they were trying to keep afloat. For more serious offending, time in prison is even a possibility.

"Our message to the community is clear: deliberately ignoring your obligations comes at a significant cost."

A 2016 government task force estimated Australia's shadow economy could be worth as much as 3 per cent of GDP, or approximately $50 billion in 2016 figures.

More recent ATO estimates show the shadow economy has continued to grow, reaching up to 5.4 per cent of GDP in 2023.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 随着当局打击影子经济，数百人和企业因税务犯罪被起诉，并被处以数百万美元的罚款。 澳大利亚税务局(ATO)周四透露，过去两年来，针对“狡猾的影子经济运营商”的未提交起诉增加了80%，并警告那些违反规定的人将被追究责任。 影子经济涉及合法和非法的经济活动，包括要求支付工作现金（称为“现金”）以避税，以及少付养老金等应享权利。 ATO 表示，过去两年已有超过 350 名个人或企业被成功起诉，并被处以超过 270 万澳元的罚款。 在 2025-26 财年，昆士兰州占未提出起诉的 28%，其次是西澳大利亚州（26%）和新南威尔士州（20%）。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 ATO助理局长托尼·戈丁（Tony Goding）表示，一些人认为逃避税收和养老金义务是一种无受害人的犯罪行为，但却给社区带来了代价。 他说：“影子经济损害了合法企业，并减少了收入，而这些收入本来可以为支持所有澳大利亚人的基本公共服务提供资金。” “无论你从事什么职业，如果你是技工、美发师或咖啡馆老板，如果你故意逃避缴纳适当的税款，那么你面临的风险就不仅仅是经济处罚。” 在这些起诉中，超过 305 起被定罪，比 2024-25 和 2025-26 财政年度增加了近 60%。 戈丁表示，这些数据表明澳大利亚税务局正在追究那些违反规定的人的责任。 他说：“故意违法的人会拿自己的名誉和未来冒险，刑事定罪的影响超出了法庭范围。” “我们已经看到企业主被定罪，失去客户和社区的信任，在某些情况下，甚至失去了他们试图维持的业务。对于更严重的犯罪行为，甚至有可能入狱。 “我们向社区传达的信息很明确：故意忽视你的义务将会付出巨大的代价。” 2016 年政府工作组估计，澳大利亚影子经济的价值可能高达 GDP 的 3%，即 2016 年的数据约为 500 亿澳元。 ATO 最近的估计显示，影子经济持续增长，到 2023 年将达到 GDP 的 5.4%。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The Australian Taxation Office's aggressive pursuit of tax evasion, resulting in hundreds of prosecutions and millions in fines, underscores a commitment to economic justice. This crackdown on the 'shadow economy' reminds us that integrity in financial dealings is a matter of communal well-being, reflecting the call to 'act justly.'
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚税务局对逃税行为的严厉打击，导致数百起诉讼和数百万澳元的罚款，这表明了对经济公正的承诺。这次对“影子经济”的打击提醒我们，财务往来的诚信关系到社区的福祉，体现了‘秉公行义’的呼召。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tony Burke unveils major migration changes to tighten Australia's visa system — as it happened
title.zh: 现场更新：托尼·伯克谈移民改革，关键变化已揭晓

summary.en: The announcement comes as new figures show net overseas migration has fallen. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke is detailing sweeping changes to Australia's immigration system, emphasizing the role of migration in shaping modern Australia and the significance of citizenship ceremonies.
summary.zh: 此公告发布之际，最新数据显示净海外移民人数有所下降。内政部长托尼·伯克正在详细介绍澳大利亚移民系统的重大改革，强调移民在塑造现代澳大利亚中的作用以及公民身份仪式的意义。

body.en:
Thanks for joining Miles Proust and me today as we covered the government's long-awaited unveiling of its migration shake-up.

You can find out more about the migration changes on SBS World News at 6.30pm AEST and via OnDemand , including analysis by SBS News' chief political correspondent Anna Henderson.

SBS News will also publish more stories in the coming days to help you understand how these changes may affect you and your community.

You can also download our app and  subscribe to our newsletter . It's the best way to stay across our updates, explainers and analysis as we continue covering these changes.

Kon Karapanagiotidis, CEO and founder of the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre, says the changes announced today mark "a dark day for multicultural Australia".

"Today our government chose to turn on migrants, international students and people seeking asylum who have built lives here, contributed to this country and asked for nothing more than the chance to belong," Karapanagiotidis said in a statement.

He was particularly concerned about how the changes would affect those seeking asylum, as well as plans to ramp up detention centre use for those overstaying their visas, saying they were reminiscent of US President Donald Trump's ICE immigration raids.

"Minister Burke went to great lengths to reassure Australians this would not look like Donald Trump's immigration raids.

"But look at what is actually being planned: 500 more compliance officers tasked with finding people, 1,250 more detention beds including plans to turn former COVID quarantine facilities in Victoria into detention centres, and billions more for removals."

He said the changes would double Australia's immigration detention regime and argued they would make Australia "smaller, meaner and more divided".

"We will not stand by while migrants and refugees are used as political punching bags," he added.

"We will fight any attempt to take away the right to work or shut people out of seeking protection."

Here's a look back at some bits you may have missed from today's eagerly awaited migration plan.

A ballot system will be introduced for second and third-year working holiday-makers, who are required to work regionally.

Only 45,000 working holiday-makers will be able to stay in Australia for a second year, and just 5,000 for a third year — down from 57,000 and 31,000 respectively.

British citizens will remain exempt from having to work regionally in their second and third years, with the government honouring a free trade agreement between Australia and the UK.

People who overstay their visas will be taken into detention, reviving a policy that was in place before 2015.

The government will also seek more facilities, compliance officers and beds to prepare for the...
body.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克在堪培拉开始了他的全国新闻俱乐部演讲，他将详细介绍澳大利亚移民制度的全面改革。 部长首先强调今天是公民日，以及移民在塑造现代澳大利亚中所发挥的作用，并将公民身份描述为移民之旅的顶峰。 他将入籍仪式描述为澳大利亚“最快乐、最爱国的活动”之一，人们在仪式上对澳大利亚做出终生承诺，并受到澳大利亚社会的欢迎。 伯克承认移民体系中持续存在的挑战，但他表示，重要的是不要忽视移民对国家的更广泛贡献。 “我们永远不能忽视现代、多元文化的澳大利亚国家结构的非凡力量。” 政府还将更新第 110 号部长指示，通过更好地保护犯罪行为的儿童受害者以及家庭暴力受害者来打击仇恨和犯罪行为。 内政部长托尼·伯克将在全国新闻俱乐部的讲话中提供该计划的更多细节。 当托尼·伯克开始他的全国新闻俱乐部演讲时，我们现在知道了政府移民改革的关键细节。 联邦政府减少临时移民的计划包括驱逐非法非公民、打击“跳签证”以及为第二年和第三年背包客引入投票制度等。 大多数学生签证的家庭申请人将受到限制，所有访客签证都将引入“不得进一步居留”的条件，而明知无理支持签证申请的“流氓移民代理”也将成为目标。 优先处理将分配给技术移民途径中的关键部门，包括医疗保健、建筑、教育、执法、国防、资源、农业、水产养殖和渔业。 伯克表示，联邦政府支持移民，但“反对任何人破坏移民制度”。 “几乎每个来到澳大利亚的人都是我们国家的好客人。这些改革是为了确保我们的移民制度能够更好地针对澳大利亚当前的需求，”他说。 这些措施旨在将澳大利亚本财年的海外净移民人数减少至245,000人，并在2027-28财年减少至225,000人。 截至 2026 年 3 月的一年中，海外净移民人数已降至 292,000 人，略低于 12 月的 299,000 人。 该数据发布前不到一个小时，内政部长托尼·伯克(Tony Burke)发布了工党新的移民计划和减少海外净移民的战略。 最新数据显示，与去年相比，人数减少了 17,400 人（5.6%）。 有很多争论...

reflection.en: Minister Tony Burke highlighted Citizenship Day and the joyful, patriotic nature of citizenship ceremonies, framing them as the culmination of an immigration journey. This reflects a governmental responsibility to ensure the immigration system upholds justice and serves the well-being of both newcomers and the nation, as mandated for leaders. May those who...
reflection.zh: 托尼·部长强调了公民日以及公民仪式所带来的喜悦和爱国氛围，将其视为移民旅程的顶点。这反映了政府有责任确保移民体系维护公正，并服务于新移民和国家福祉，正如对领导者的要求一样。 愿执政者铭记，他们最高的使命是施行公正与公义，确保所有寻求新家园的人受到尊重和公平对待，并通过明智和富有同情心的政策来加强国家。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong Desk
title.zh: 香港快讯

strap.en: News, policy, and public life in Hong Kong.
strap.zh: 聚焦香港时事、政策与社会动态。

title.en: Hong Kong to legislate against persistent child sexual abuse and ‘cyberflashing’
title.zh: 香港将立法打击持续的儿童性虐待和“网络闪照”

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities announced plans to introduce legislation against persistent child sexual abuse and the non-consensual online sharing of explicit images. This move follows public consultation and aims to address serious harms to children and individuals.
summary.zh: 香港当局宣布计划立法，打击持续的儿童性虐待以及未经同意在网上分享露骨图像的行为。此举是在公众咨询之后提出的，旨在解决对儿童和个人造成的严重伤害。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities have said they will legislate against persistent sexual abuse of children and the act of sending images of genitals to others online without consent after consulting the public. In a consultation report published on Thursday, the Security Bureau stated that with the city’s two professional legal associations expressing broad support for a dedicated law targeting persistent child sexual abuse, the government would include the crime in an amendment bill overhauling sex...
body.zh: 香港当局表示，在征求公众意见后，他们将立法禁止持续性虐待儿童以及未经同意在网上向他人发送生殖器图像的行为。在周四发布的一份咨询报告中，安全局表示，随着该市的两个专业法律协会对针对持续存在的儿童性虐待的专门法律表示广泛支持，政府将把这一罪行纳入一项全面改革性虐待的修正案中……

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Security Bureau's commitment to legislating against child sexual abuse and "cyberflashing" reflects a crucial step in protecting the vulnerable. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This legislative action embodies that principle by creating legal safeguards...
reflection.zh: 香港保安局承诺立法打击儿童性虐待和“网络闪照”，这体现了保护弱势群体的重要一步。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“要为不能言语的开口，为一切孤苦人伸冤”。这项立法行动通过为儿童和遭受此类虐待的其他人创建法律保障，体现了这一原则。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: 100 start-ups joining Hong Kong’s flagship tech hub to get top mentors
title.zh: 100家初创公司加入香港旗舰科技中心接受顶尖导师指导

summary.en: Approximately 100 start-ups have been selected to join Hong Kong's flagship innovation and technology park. These companies will participate in mentorship programs lasting five to eight years, supported by industry leaders. The selection process involved several months of screening, according to Vincent Ma, CEO of...
summary.zh: 约有100家初创公司被选中加入香港的旗舰创新及科技园。据Loop Hong Kong Park Company首席执行官Vincent Ma透露，这些公司将接受为期五至八年的导师计划，并获得行业领袖的支持。甄选过程经过了数月的严格筛选。

body.en: Around 100 start-ups selected to join Hong Kong’s flagship border tech hub will undergo mentorship programmes ranging from five to eight years, backed by industry heavyweights, the operator has revealed. Vincent Ma, CEO of Loop Hong Kong Park Company, said in an interview on Thursday that the start-ups were chosen to join the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park (HSITP) following a months-long screening process. “We have chosen 100 start-ups to enter our park soon following a few...
body.zh: 该运营商透露，被选中加入香港旗舰边境科技中心的约 100 家初创企业将接受为期五年至八年的指导计划，并得到行业重量级人物的支持。路套香港园区公司首席执行官马永康周四在接受采访时表示，经过长达数月的筛选过程，这些初创企业被选入港深创新及科技园（HSITP）。 “我们选择了 100 家初创企业入驻我们的园区，不久之后...

reflection.en: This initiative in Hong Kong aims to nurture 100 start-ups through extensive mentorship, offering them a significant runway for growth. It reflects a commitment to fostering innovation and providing seasoned guidance. As these ventures embark on their journey, the ancient wisdom to commit their work to Yahweh, trusting that their plans will succeed through...
reflection.zh: 香港这项计划旨在通过广泛的导师指导来培育100家初创公司，为它们的成长提供重要的支持。这体现了对促进创新和提供经验丰富指导的承诺。当这些企业踏上征程之际，那句古老的智慧——将你的事交托给雅伟，使你所谋定的得以成就——为它们的努力提供了深刻的视角。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Self-funded campuses favoured in Hong Kong’s new university towns
title.zh: 香港新大学城倾向于自费校园

summary.en: Hong Kong's education minister has indicated that tertiary institutions looking to establish campuses in the planned Northern Metropolis university towns will receive "favourable consideration" if they can fund their facilities without government loans. Applications are now open for interested institutions.
summary.zh: 香港教育局局长表示，有意在计划中的北部都会区大学城设立校区的大学，若能自费建设设施而无需政府贷款，将获得“优先考虑”。有意向的机构现已开放申请。

body.en: Tertiary institutions seeking to establish campuses in one of three university towns planned for the Northern Metropolis megaproject will be given “favourable consideration” if they do not require a government loan to build their facilities, Hong Kong’s education minister has said. The government has expanded all three university towns – formally named in Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu’s annual policy address on Wednesday – and opened applications for interested institutions to submit their...
body.zh: 香港教育部长表示，如果高等教育机构不需要政府贷款来建设设施，那么寻求在北方都市大型项目计划的三个大学城之一建立校园的高等教育机构将得到“有利考虑”。政府已经扩大了所有三个大学城——行政长官李家超周三的年度施政报告中正式命名——并向感兴趣的机构开放申请，以提交他们的...

reflection.en: As Hong Kong plans its new university towns, the government is prioritizing institutions that can self-fund their campuses. This approach reflects a commitment to self-reliance and careful stewardship of resources. May those undertaking these significant projects commit their plans and resources to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and wisdom in...
reflection.zh: 香港在规划新的大学城时，政府优先考虑能够自费建设校区的机构。这种方法体现了对自力更生和审慎管理资源的重视。愿那些承担这些重大项目的人将他们的计划和资源托付给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以期成功并智慧地建设未来。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'AI City Brain' is for emergency services: govt
title.zh: “智慧城市”用于紧急服务：政府

summary.en: Hong Kong's government announced that a new integrated city management system utilizing artificial intelligence, dubbed 'AI City Brain,' will complete its initial development phase by early 2028 and mature over the next six to nine years. Officials emphasized that the system is intended for improving daily city...
summary.zh: 香港政府周四表示，一个内置人工智能的新型综合城市管理系统将于2028年第一季度完成第一阶段开发，而整个系统则需要六到九年才能成熟。官员们强调，“智慧城市大脑”将不会用于犯罪侦查或监控目的，其目的是通过“大数据分析”整合相关大数据并向政府部门提供实时信息，以改善日常城市管理和应急响应。

body.en: The government said on Thursday that a new integrated city management system with built-in artificial intelligence will complete the first phase of development by the first quarter of 2028, while the full system will take six to nine years to mature. Officials stressed "AI City Brain" will not be used for crime-detection or surveillance purposes, saying the aim is to improve day-to-day city management and emergency response. Under the plan announced in Wednesday's Policy Address, "AI City Brain" would "link up and consolidate relevant big data" and feed real-time information to government departments through "big data analytics". Chief Secretary Eric Chan, who will lead a task force to take forward the initiative, said HK$200 million has been earmarked for the first phase of the system's buildout. "Total budget is not yet... we do not have any estimation now, because you know that after six to nine years, I really don't know how fast or how cheap the IT is, maybe the prices could go down quickly," he said. He added that by the third quarter of 2028, the system is expected to connect to the 1823 Contact Centre and the databases of emergency services. "I want to reiterate that the "[AI] City Brain" system is not for crime detection. It is for city management. This is a very important principle," he said. "These computer systems, they're now operating separately, independently, I would say, in different departments. But I think we want to, we want them to integrate into a single system, and adding the function of AI, then we can predict any disasters or any accidents from happening. This is a very, very important purpose." At the same press conference, Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the new Huanggang port is expected to start operating by the fourth quarter of this year. He said more than 100 system trials, stress tests and drills have been conducted so far, helping officials to rectify issues such as Wi-Fi connectivity and slippery driveways at the public transport interchange. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 政府周四表示，内置人工智能的新型综合城市管理系统将于 2028 年第一季度完成第一阶段开发，而整个系统需要六到九年的时间才能成熟。官员们强调，“人工智能城市大脑”不会用于犯罪侦查或监视目的，称其目的是改善日常城市管理和应急响应。根据周三施政报告公布的计划，“人工智能城市大脑”将“连接和整合相关大数据”，并通过“大数据分析”向政府部门提供实时信息。政务司司长陈家祥将率领一个专责小组推进这项计划，他表示已预留 2 亿港元用于该系统第一阶段的建设。 “总预算还没有……我们现在没有任何估计，因为你知道，六到九年后，我真的不知道IT的速度有多快或有多便宜，也许价格会很快下降，”他说。他补充说，到2028年第三季度，该系统预计将连接到1823联络中心和紧急服务数据库。 “我想重申，‘人工智能城市大脑’系统不是为了犯罪侦查，而是为了城市管理。这是一个非常重要的原则，”他说。 “这些计算机系统，我想说，它们现在在不同的部门单独、独立地运行。但我认为我们希望，我们希望它们集成到一个系统中，并添加人工智能的功能，然后我们可以预测任何灾难或任何事故的发生。这是一个非常非常重要的目的。”在同一场新闻发布会上，保安局局长唐英年表示，新皇岗口岸预计将于今年第四季度投入运营。他说，到目前为止，已经进行了100多次系统试验、压力测试和演习，帮助官员纠正公共交通交汇处的Wi-Fi连接和车道湿滑等问题。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen in Hong Kong's 'AI City Brain' project, reflects a world where knowledge and data processing are accelerating. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the "time of the end," a prophecy that resonates with our current era of unprecedented technological growth. As we develop powerful tools like AI, may we...
reflection.zh: 香港“智慧城市大脑”项目所展现的技术飞速发展，反映了一个知识和数据处理日益加速的世界。但以理书12:4预言“末期”知识将增长，这与我们当前前所未有的技术增长时代产生了共鸣。当我们开发人工智能等强大工具时，愿我们寻求智慧，将其用于共同利益，确保它们服务于人类而非控制人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Sep 17
title.zh: 行政长官周四就最新政策蓝图回答议员及公众提问

summary.en: The Chief Executive will address questions from lawmakers and the public regarding his latest policy blueprints on Thursday.
summary.zh: 行政长官将于周四就其最新政策蓝图回答议员及公众的提问。

reflection.en: As leaders present their visions and plans, the call to 'act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God' echoes through the halls of governance. May those in power seek wisdom not just for effective policy, but for policies that reflect divine justice and compassion for all citizens.
reflection.zh: 当领导者提出他们的愿景和计划时，‘行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行’的呼召在治理的殿堂中回响。愿掌权者不仅寻求有效的政策，更寻求能反映雅伟的公义和对所有公民的怜悯的政策。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Innovation spending boost by 2030 'aggressive target'
title.zh: 2030年创新支出翻倍目标‘雄心勃勃’

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Sun Dong, has stated that the government aims to nearly double its spending on innovation within the next five years. This initiative, part of the city's first five-year blueprint, seeks to increase domestic innovation expenditure from 1.63% of GDP in 2024...
summary.zh: 创新、科技及工业局局长孙东表示，政府的目标是在未来五年内将创新方面的支出几乎翻倍。这是香港首份五年规划的一部分，旨在将本地创新活动支出从2024年的占本地生产总值的1.63%提高到2030年的3%。孙形容这是一个‘雄心勃勃的目标’，旨在推动政府和行业的投资。

body.en: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said he hopes the government's goal of almost doubling spending on innovation in the coming five years will attract more funds to the city. According to Hong Kong's inaugural five-year blueprint, the SAR will strive to raise domestic expenditure on innovation activities to 3 percent of GDP by 2030 from 1.63 percent in 2024. "This is a relatively aggressive target," Sun told reporters. "We want to use this indicator to measure as well as to push for more investments on these innovation activities – not only from government side, but also mainly from the industry. "In Hong Kong, as we are pressing ahead with the new industrialisation development, we hope in the coming five years more investment from industry will go to the innovation activities, including now we also encourage many enterprises to establish R&D centres and so on." Sun said the target would cover not only expenditure on basic applied research commonly seen in universities, but also activities by enterprises such as product design, software development and pilot production. The government also expects a 10 percent increase in average annual expenditure in the next five years. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 创新科技及工业局局长孙东表示，他希望政府在未来五年将创新支出增加近一倍的目标将吸引更多资金流入香港。根据香港首个五年蓝图，香港特区将力争到2030年将国内创新活动支出占GDP的比例从2024年的1.63%提高到3%。“这是一个相对激进的目标，”孙告诉记者。 “我们希望通过这个指标来衡量，并推动对这些创新活动的更多投资——不仅是政府方面，而且主要是来自工业界。在香港，随着我们正在推进新型工业化发展，我们希望未来五年工业界能有更多的投资投向创新活动，包括现在我们也鼓励很多企业建立研发中心等等。”孙说，这个目标不仅包括大学里常见的基础应用研究的支出，还包括企业的活动，例如产品设计、软件等。政府还预计未来五年的年均支出将增加 10%（Edmond Fong 编辑）。

reflection.en: Hong Kong is setting an ambitious target to significantly increase its investment in innovation and technology. This drive for progress and development reflects a human desire to build and create, seeking a better future. As plans are made and resources are allocated, may the efforts be guided by wisdom and a commitment to excellence, trusting that the...
reflection.zh: 香港设定了一个雄心勃勃的目标，旨在大幅增加对创新和技术的投资。这种对进步和发展的追求反映了人类建设和创造、寻求更美好未来的愿望。在制定计划和分配资源时，愿这些努力都能得到智慧的指引和卓越的承诺，并信靠最终的成果都在雅伟的手中。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: ‘No doubt’ of climate change role in deadly China-Nepal flood: scientists
title.zh: 科学家：气候变化是导致中尼边境洪灾的“核心因素”

summary.en: Scientists have identified climate change as a primary factor in a recent glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border, which resulted in over 1,400 deaths and left 6,600 missing. The disaster was characterized as a 'compound crisis' involving long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw, and geological...
summary.zh: 科学家们指出，气候变化是近期中尼边境冰川山体崩塌的主要因素，此次灾难已导致超过1400人死亡，另有6600人失踪。该事件被描述为一场“复合危机”，涉及长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定，而非单一的极端天气事件。

body.en: Climate change was a core factor in last month’s deadly glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border that killed more than 1,400 people and left at least 6,600 missing, scientists said Thursday. A man looks at the remains in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 7, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP. However, scientists from the World Weather Attribution (WWA) group said, the disaster was not caused by a single extreme weather event, rather a “compound crisis” shaped by long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw and geological instability. “Relentless warming has lifted the altitude of the freezing threshold on the high Himalaya, exposing ice and permafrost deep in the bedrock to higher and longer thaw temperatures, weakening mountain slopes,” a WWA report said. A massive section of rock and glacier broke away from Langtang Lirung mountain on August 26, triggering a huge flood of water, ice and debris that swept downstream, destroying communities and infrastructure. ‘Irreversible shifts’ Report co-author Walter Immerzeel, a mountain hydrologist at Utrecht University, said the region was undergoing “fundamental, irreversible shifts”, with glacier retreat and permafrost degradation undermining mountain stability. “We conclude that this was a geologically vulnerable slope, potentially weakened by the 2015 earthquake, but it was destabilised further by glacier retreat and permafrost fall,” Immerzeel told reporters. Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people, contributes a fraction of global greenhouse gas emissions compared to industrialised nations. The study found that July and August 2026 were the warmest months locally recorded, while heavy snowfall in late 2025 contributed to increased meltwater before the collapse. A magnitude 7.8 earthquake in Nepal in 2015 may have further weakened the slope, although its precise role remains uncertain, the report said. Workers repair a section of road leading to Gyirong Port on August 28, 2026, which was damaged after a mudslide two days earlier, in Gyirong County. Photo: CNS/AFP. Last month’s disaster has also raised concerns about the limits of adaptation. Prime Minister Balendra Shah will take his first foreign trip as Nepal’s leader to address the UN General Assembly on the urgent issue next week. Nepal estimates the reconstruction bill after deadly floods sparked by a glacial mountain collapse last month will amount to $4.78 billion. ‘No doubt’ “There is no doubt that climate change is one of the drivers, and therefore obviously it needs to be discussed in the context of loss and damage,” Friederike Otto, a professor of climate science at...
body.zh: 科学家周四表示，气候变化是上个月中尼边境致命冰川山崩塌的核心因素，这场崩塌造成 1,400 多人死亡，至少 6,600 人失踪。 2026 年 9 月 7 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区特里苏里，一名男子正在查看山洪暴发后的遗骸。照片：Pedro Pardo/法新社。然而，世界天气归因组织（WWA）的科学家表示，这场灾难并不是单一的极端天气事件造成的，而是由长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定所形成的“复合危机”。世界气象组织的一份报告称：“持续的变暖提高了喜马拉雅山高处的冰冻阈值，使基岩深处的冰和永久冻土暴露在更高和更长时间的解冻温度下，削弱了山坡。” 8 月 26 日，一大片岩石和冰川从 Langtang Lirung 山脱落，引发洪水、冰和碎片席卷下游，摧毁了社区和基础设施。 “不可逆转的变化”报告的合著者、乌得勒支大学山区水文学家沃尔特·伊默泽尔表示，该地区正在经历“根本性的、不可逆转的变化”，冰川退缩和永久冻土退化破坏了山区的稳定性。伊默泽尔告诉记者：“我们的结论是，这是一个地质脆弱的斜坡，可能会因 2015 年地震而变得脆弱，但冰川退缩和永久冻土层塌陷进一步破坏了它的稳定性。”尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，与工业化国家相比，其温室气体排放量仅占全球温室气体排放量的一小部分。研究发现，2026年7月和8月是当地有记录以来最温暖的月份，而2025年末的大雪导致崩塌前融水增加。报告称，2015 年尼泊尔发生的 7.8 级地震可能进一步削弱了斜坡，但其确切作用仍不确定。 2026 年 8 月 28 日，工人们正在修复吉隆县通往吉隆口岸的一段道路，该道路因两天前的泥石流而受损。照片：CNS/法新社。上个月的灾难也引发了人们对适应局限性的担忧。巴伦德拉·沙阿总理将于下周作为尼泊尔领导人首次出访，在联合国大会上就这一紧迫问题发表讲话。尼泊尔估计上个月冰川山崩塌引发致命洪水后的重建费用将达到 47.8 亿美元。 “毫无疑问”“毫无疑问，气候变化是驱动因素之一，因此显然需要在损失和损害的背景下进行讨论，”弗里德里克·奥托（Friederike Otto），气候科学教授。

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and systemic disruption. As scientists link this devastating flood to climate change, we see a world out of balance, a consequence of long-term warming and environmental instability. May we recognize our interconnectedness with creation and seek wisdom to live as faithful stewards.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动和系统性破坏的重负。当科学家们将这场毁灭性的洪水与气候变化联系起来时，我们看到了一个失衡的世界，这是长期变暖和环境不稳定的后果。愿我们认识到与受造界的相互联系，并寻求智慧，作为忠实的管家生活。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Man jailed 4 weeks for grabbing passerby by the neck and attempting to kiss her
title.zh: 男子因非礼罪被判监禁四周

summary.en: A 29-year-old man in Hong Kong has been sentenced to four weeks in prison for indecent assault after pleading guilty to grabbing a female passerby by the neck and attempting to kiss her. The incident occurred in the early hours of Tuesday in Shau Kei Wan.
summary.zh: 一名29岁的香港男子因非礼罪被判处四周监禁。他承认在周二凌晨于筲箕湾袭击一名路过的女子，抓住她的脖子并试图亲吻她。

body.en: A Hong Kong man accused of grabbing the neck of a female passerby and attempting to kiss her has been sentenced to four weeks in prison for indecent assault. Eastern Law Courts Building. Photo: Almond Li/HKFP. Fung Ho-yin, 29, appeared at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday, The Witness reported . He pleaded guilty to a charge of indecent assault stemming from an incident in the early hours of Tuesday in Shau Kei Wan. Fung was sitting on a bench in a park on Nam On Street at around 1am that day when a woman – known to the court as X – walked past him, according to the prosecution. Fung first attempted to take a photo of X. He then stood up and followed her, and wrapped his left arm around X’s neck while using his other arm to touch her chest. He also tried to kiss her, the prosecution said. X managed to escape and screamed for help. Nam On Street Sitting-out Area in Shau Kei Wan. Photo: Wikicommons. She got the attention of a man inside a nearby gym, who ran out and helped her. X then called the police. Officers arrived at the scene and arrested Fung, who admitted under police caution that he had committed the offence out of impulse, The Witness reported. He told police he was attracted to X’s miniskirt and hoped to get close to and speak with her. But X noticed him approach and told him to go away, he said. See also: Hong Kong court acquits gov’t statistician who followed, photographed girl during school open day Handing down the sentence, Magistrate Kestrel Lam said the incident occurred in the quiet of the night, and that the consequences would have been hard to predict if nobody had come forward. He said that even though Fung had no criminal record, this was a serious case that warranted imprisonment, Ming Pao reported . Indecent assault is punishable by up to 10 years’ imprisonment, although jail terms in magistrates’ courts are capped at two years for a single offence.
body.zh: 一名香港男子被控抓住一名女性路人的脖子并试图亲吻她，因猥亵罪被判处四个星期监禁。东区法院大楼。照片：Almond Li/HKFP。据《见证人》报道，29 岁的冯浩然周三在东区裁判法院出庭。他承认因周二凌晨在筲箕湾发生的一起事件而被控猥亵罪。检方称，当天凌晨 1 点左右，冯正坐在南安街一个公园的长凳上，一名女子（法庭称 X）从他身边走过。冯先尝试给X拍照，然后起身跟随X，左臂搂住X的脖子，另一只手抚摸X的胸部。检方称，他还试图亲吻她。 X成功逃脱并大声呼救。筲箕湾南安街休憩处。照片：维基共享资源。她引起了附近健身房内一名男子的注意，后者跑出去帮助了她。 X随后报了警。据《见证人》报道，警察赶到现场并逮捕了冯，冯在警方的警告下承认自己是出于冲动而犯罪。他告诉警方，他被X的迷你裙所吸引，希望能接近她并与她交谈。但 X 注意到他走近并告诉他走开，他说。另请参阅：香港法院宣判一名政府统计员无罪，该统计员在学校开放日期间跟踪并拍摄了一名女孩。 裁判官林凯斯特在宣判时表示，这起事件发生在深夜，如果没有人挺身而出，后果将难以预测。据《明报》报道，他表示，尽管冯没有犯罪记录，但案情严重，应入狱。猥亵罪最高可判处 10 年监禁，但治安法院对单次犯罪的刑期上限为两年。

reflection.en: This incident highlights the vulnerability of individuals in public spaces and the violation of personal boundaries. The legal system has responded with a sentence, but the deeper wound of assault and the fear it instills remain. We are called to defend the oppressed and seek justice, ensuring that such violations are not overlooked and that victims find...

title.en: European ash pangenome could help researchers breed a generation of trees resistant to ash dieback

summary.en: In a study published in the journal Nature Communications, researchers from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Forest Research and collaborating organizations present the first-ever European ash (Fraxinus excelsior) pangenome, using high-quality DNA to aid research into natural ash dieback resistance. Using the...
summary.zh: 在《Nature Communications》杂志上发表的一项研究中，来自邱园、英国林业研究中心及合作组织的科学家们公布了首个欧洲白蜡树（Fraxinus...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

In a study published in the journal Nature Communications , researchers from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Forest Research and collaborating organizations present the first-ever European ash (Fraxinus excelsior) pangenome, using high-quality DNA to aid research into natural ash dieback resistance.

Using the pangenome, constructed from a group of 50 trees of diverse origins, the scientists analyzed a genomic dataset from more than 1,000 trees to identify genes associated with resistance. They found 211 genes with possible links to ash dieback resistance, 16 of which were dispensable, meaning they were present in only some individual trees and not across the board.

Unlike genes found in every individual of a species, dispensable genes are not always essential. They may, however, confer traits advantageous in certain contexts, like disease resistance or better drought tolerance, potentially allowing populations to adapt more quickly to changing circumstances.

A traditional genome assembly approach captures information from only a single individual—only a pangenome allows dispensable genes to be identified.

In total, the researchers identified more than 3,400 genes as dispensable across the trees sampled. Although they represent only 9% of all genes, these may play a critical role in determining differences between individuals.

Unlocking these data could enable researchers to more accurately predict which trees are likely to be genetically shielded against ash dieback disease, caused by the fungus Hymenoscyphus fraxineus, and could help breed resistant populations by identifying the most promising trees from their genetic code alone.

Ash dieback is a major concern for the UK and has decimated British treescapes since first being detected in 2012, killing millions of trees. Only a tiny proportion of trees—as low as 0.5%—remain healthy after long-term disease exposure.

Pangenomes provide a more comprehensive way of studying susceptibility to pathogens, compared with using a single genome, as they capture the dispensable DNA sequences carried by some trees but not others. In fact, the pangenome constructed in this study was 22% larger than a high-quality genome from a single ash individual when accounting for dispensable genetic sequences.

Dr. Daniel Wood, Kew research fellow and first author, says, "If each ash genome is the same movie, these findings highlight how many director's cuts, extended editions, deleted scenes and alternate endings nevertheless exist in wild populations—perhaps most of the runtime is the same, but the variable bits can potentially make the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在《自然通讯》杂志上发表的一项研究中，来自皇家植物园、邱园、森林研究和合作组织的研究人员提出了有史以来第一个欧洲白蜡树 (Fraxinus excelsior) 全基因组，利用高质量 DNA 来帮助研究天然白蜡树顶枯病抗性。 科学家们利用由 50 棵不同来源的树木组成的泛基因组，分析了 1000 多棵树木的基因组数据集，以确定与抗性相关的基因。他们发现了 211 个基因可能与白蜡树顶枯病抗性有关，其中 16 个基因是可有可无的，这意味着它们只存在于某些个别树木中，而不是普遍存在。 与物种中每个个体中发现的基因不同，可有可无的基因并不总是必不可少的。然而，它们可能在某些情况下赋予有利的性状，例如抗病性或更好的耐旱性，从而可能使种群更快地适应不断变化的环境。 传统的基因组组装方法仅捕获来自单个个体的信息——只有泛基因组才能识别可有可无的基因。 研究人员总共发现了 3,400 多个基因在采样的树木中是可有可无的。尽管它们仅占所有基因的 9%，但它们可能在决定个体之间的差异方面发挥关键作用。 解锁这些数据可以使研究人员更准确地预测哪些树木可能在基因上免受白蜡树顶枯病（由真菌 Hymenoscyphus fraxineus 引起）的影响，并且可以通过仅从遗传密码中识别最有希望的树木来帮助培育抗性种群。 白蜡树顶枯病是英国的一个主要问题，自 2012 年首次发现以来，白蜡树顶枯病已经严重破坏了英国的树木景观，导致数百万棵树死亡。只有一小部分树木（低至 0.5%）在长期接触疾病后仍保持健康。 与使用单一基因组相比，泛基因组提供了一种更全面的研究病原体易感性的方法，因为它们捕获了某些树木而非其他树木携带的可有可无的 DNA 序列。事实上，在考虑可有可无的基因序列时，本研究构建的全基因组比单个白蜡个体的高质量基因组大 22%。 邱园研究员兼第一作者丹尼尔·伍德博士说：“如果每个灰烬基因组都是同一部电影，这些发现突显了野生种群中仍然存在多少导演剪辑、加长版、删除的场景和替代结局——也许大部分运行时间是相同的，但可变位可能会使……

reflection.en: Scientists have sequenced the European ash pangenome, a significant step in understanding how to breed trees resistant to ash dieback. This endeavor, rooted in meticulous observation and analysis of the natural world, echoes the ancient wisdom found in Job: 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you; or...
